articleTitle: Basic Medical Information Sharing System Design Based on IoT Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To make the hospital information management adapt to the development of modernization, this paper integrates the Internet of things(IoT) technology into the hospital information management system, and gives the specific architecture and construction ideas. We designed the overall structure framework and information system function framework of hospital information management system. Then, the hardware and software structure of the whole system and their implementation are provided, including the implementation of the interface function of the IoT and the expansion of the model. Finally, a regional medical information data sharing platform based on cloud computing is established by SOA, web services and other technologies, and the core functions of the system are tested. The operation results show that the scheme can realize the remote medical information monitoring, the real-time transmission and real-time sharing of cloud computing, big data and traditional Chinese medicine information, and enhance the flexibility and security of smart hospital service access.

articleTitle: Real-time Lane Detection Method Based On Region Of Interest
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the low accuracy and real-time performance of existing lane line recognition algorithms, a new lane line detection method based on region of interest was proposed. In the image preprocessing, nonlinear transformation is used to enhance the image contrast, and an improved multi-angle edge detection method is used to extract lane edges. According to prior knowledge, the recognition region of interest is established in polar coordinates, and the line segment is detected by the improved Hough transform method. The least square method is used to fit the dashed lane lines, and then the lane line direction is predicted according to the road model. The lane line identification is completed with Visual Studio 2013 platform. The experimental result shows that the algorithm can accurately identify lane lines and predict lane direction under variable lighting conditions, with the recognition accuracy up to 97.54%, and the average time consumption per frame is 0.015s. Compared with traditional detection methods, the accuracy of the proposed algorithm is improved by 9.1% and the average recognition speed is improved by 81.9%.

articleTitle: Time-frequency domain analysis of the dynamic response for the deck arch bridge based on classical vehicle-bridge coupling theory
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper focuses on the dynamic response problem after replacing the girder of the deck-arch bridge. Based on a simple vehicle-bridge coupled model, the load is simplified to a constant force moving at a constant speed by Midas software. The working conditions were considered that the vehicle weight was 63.8t, and the speed was 60km/h, 80km/h, and 100km/h. A finite element model of the bridge was established to calculate the dynamic response under vehicle load, then the result was performed domain and frequency domain analysis. The results show that the stiffness of the beam is softer than the arch. Under the same conditions, the dynamic response of the beam is more obvious than the vault position. The amplitude of the dynamic response in the key sections is concentrated in the range of 0Hz to 15Hz. The main frequency was around 1.6 Hz, 3.7 Hz, and 8.6Hz corresponding to the second, fifth, and eighth natural frequencies of the bridge. As the vehicle speed increases, the influence of the second-order frequency was gradually increased to the dynamic characteristic of the bridge. When the vehicle frequency was close to the natural frequency of the bridge, the phenomenon of resonance was easy to occur

articleTitle: Traffic Congestion Analysis and Prediction Method based on XGBoost and LightGBM
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to alleviate the problem of urban traffic congestion a traffic congestion analysis and prediction method based on XGBoost and LightGBM integration model is proposed in this paper. This method abandons the boosting-tree model widely used in traditional data mining, using a new weight-assigning algorithm is prompted, considering both the accuracy of data acquisition and the time complexity. The experimental results show that the mean square error (RMSE) of the prompted fused model remains about 2.5, and the predicted results are also consistent with the graphical results visualized by Echarts. The method has high prediction accuracy and plays a certain role in alleviating traffic pressure.

articleTitle: Prediction model of seismic fragility for extradosed cable-stayed bridge based on machine learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of prediction model of seismic fractal for extended cable-stayed bridge, a new prediction method of seismic fractal for extended cable-stayed bridge based on machine learning is proposed in this paper. Using the structural stability of artificial neural network and the remarkable performance of processing nonlinear data, a prediction model is established to study the complex nonlinear relationship between potential influencing factors and seismic vulnerability. Based on the theoretical data, as an alternative method, the structural vulnerability is modeled and simulated by least squares support vector machine (LSSVM). Compared with the theoretical results, under the three damage states, the average absolute percentage error (MAPE) predicted by LSSVM are 0.19%, 0.12% and 0.20% respectively, and the root mean square error (RMSE) are 3.16e-04, 1.86e-04 and 4.83e-04 respectively. The research results verify the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: A Smart Mask with Identity Recognition Function Based on NFC
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the need for identification when entering public places during the epidemic, a new method for personal identification is proposed. In this paper, the personal identity information is recorded in the NFC chip, and then the NFC chip is put into the socket of the mask. Using the hardware device with NFC acquisition function, the personal identity information can be read out and uploaded to the cloud platform for personal information comparison and authentication. The scheme uses masks to achieve identity authentication that meets the requirements of contactless epidemic prevention and control, it is applicable to factories, schools and other places with dense personnel and the need for personnel information investigation. It can improve the of personnel epidemic prevention information inspection when entering, and reduce the investigation pressure on personnel entering and leaving.

articleTitle: Optimization Method of power grid data fusion for High Proportion New Energy System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to take into account the randomness and intermittency of renewable energy, appropriate energy storage is usually configured in power systems to improve system flexibility. However, the differences between energy storage types and equipment are not fully considered in the traditional energy storage optimization allocation problem. Firstly, the generation of unbalanced power of power supply load in the power system is analyzed. Combined with the characteristics of pumped storage and battery energy storage, two kinds of energy storage are used to suppress the output fluctuation of low frequency and high frequency, respectively. Then, the discrete Fourier transform is studied first, and on this basis, the distribution power of the two kinds of energy storage is obtained. In this paper, the operation cost of energy storage investment, the loss cost of power shortage and the penalty cost of wind curtailment are comprehensively compared and analyzed. The optimal allocation model of hybrid energy storage system is constructed and solved by particle swarm optimization algorithm. The example shows that the cost of the model in this paper is better than that of some existing battery-pumping storage capacity allocation methods. The addition of photothermal energy can also save energy storage investment and reduce or even avoid the reversal characteristics of the tidal current in the region.

articleTitle: Design of Asynchronous Non-blocking Network Crawler Based on Node.js
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the crawling efficiency of network crawler, make full use of CPU and realize the processing of high concurrency data, this paper proposes an asynchronous non-blocking network crawler design based on Node.js. It uses a single-threaded model to deal with concurrent data. When a client requests a connection, it triggers an internal event. Through the non-blocking I/O and event-driven mechanism, Node. js program can be parallelized macroscopically. At the same time, it constructs many asynchronous I/O APIs at the bottom, and there is no need to wait between each call. After the operation is completed, the data are processed through callback, so as to reduce the cost and complexity. It is used to write lightweight web crawlers. By acquiring the page, grasping the target content, storing it in JSON files and arrays, and then jumping to the next page, the crawling of web data is realized through several steps of obtaining detailed information. Through practical application test, it is very accurate and efficient to crawl nearly 1000 pieces of data from the webpage.

articleTitle: Prediction and Simulation of sleep stages based on EEG signals
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low efficiency and high misjudgment rate of sleep staging expert discrimination method, a sleep staging prediction model is constructed by using machine learning method. The model is mainly composed of three parts: data preprocessing, model prediction and experimental result analysis. Firstly, the EEG signals of five sleep points were standardized by Z-score; Then, KNN, lightgbm, multi classification SVM and random forest RF are used to study the prediction of sleep stages. Through the grid search method, the best classifier parameter combination is obtained in the training process and verified in the test set; Finally, four sleep stage prediction models are analyzed and evaluated by using six classifier indexes and five sleep stage confusion matrix. The accuracy rates of KNN, lightgbm, multi classification SVM and random forest RF classification models in the test set are 69.9%, 71.5%, 63.9% and 72.2% respectively. The results show that in the case of few data sets, the sleep stage prediction model based on classical multi classifier proposed in this paper can also be used to obtain a practical sleep automatic stage model.

articleTitle: Research on the construction of log parsing system based on regular expression
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the construction of various information systems and IT equipment, the types and contents of logs generated by systems and equipment are becoming more and more complex. The structures of log data generated by different systems and equipment are different, and most of them are unstructured data, which brings difficulties to log analysis and access. In order to solve the problem of heterogeneous log data identification and parsing, this paper proposes a log data grouping extraction method based on regular expression. This method adopts the strategy of separating log format description from log content parsing, and uses XML language to write script documents for log format description and log data item attribute description, As the log parsing configuration document, the script corresponds to the log type and is separated from the specific parser. Taking Apache log as an example, this paper develops a prototype system. The results show that this method not only has high parsing efficiency, but also improves the flexibility and scalability of log parsing.

articleTitle: Research on spam message recognition algorithm based on improved naive Bayes
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper focuses on the recognition algorithm of spam messages, and collects and arranges the data through the research on the current situation of spam messages at home and abroad. At the same time, businesses seek benefits by sending spam short interest such as advertising and fraud, which seriously endangers the information security and normal life of SMS users. Based on the text content of SMS, this paper establishes a recognition model to accurately identify spam SMS, so as to solve the problem of spam SMS filtering. Using python programming, Gaussian naive Bayes is used to realize text classification, and a high classification accuracy is achieved. The experiment shows that the recognition rate of this algorithm is 93.72%. Experiments show that the improved Bayesian method can effectively identify spam messages.

articleTitle: Household Intelligent Medicine Box Based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Based on STM32 single-chip microcomputer, this paper realizes an intelligent medicine box system with functions such as timing and quantitative medicine taking, temperature measurement, and SOS. On the basis of the common medicine box, the system is equipped with a WIFI module, which can remotely control the medicine box on the APP side, display the temperature change trend and receive one-key call for help. The experimental results show that the system is helpful for the elderly to take medicine conveniently and quickly, and assists children to fulfill their duty of caring for the elderly.

articleTitle: Design of medical equipment integrated management system based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In view of the poor effect of integrated management of medical equipment in China, this paper puts forward the design method of integrated management system of medical equipment based on Internet of Things. Optimizes the hardware structure configuration of the system based on Internet of Things technology, improves the system software function and operation process, and constructs a integrated management evaluation system of medical equipment. Finally, it is confirmed by experiment. The integrated management system of medical equipment based on Internet of Things has high practicability in the process of practical application. It can effectively manage massive medical equipment in real time, ensure the accuracy of information management and fully meet the research requirements.

articleTitle: Design of Liquid Level Sensor Based on Capacitance Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: There are a lot of application requirements for liquid level measurement in engineering. At present, the formula of regular or uniform field is used in the calculation of the corresponding relationship between capacitance and liquid level of the capacitance liquid level sensor, which ignores the influence of the dispersion field on the capacitance distribution. There are some problems, such as unclear effective area of liquid level measurement and low accuracy of liquid level measurement. In order to further improve the accuracy of the sensor, the finite element method is used to simulate the electric field distribution of the capacitance sensor, analyze the influence of the dispersion field on the capacitance measurement, and carry out theoretical calculation and experimental verification, finally determine the effective measurement area of the liquid level. In this paper, a liquid level sensor which can be used in both conductive and nonconductive liquids is designed, which can save cost and achieve high sensitivity. Taking the conductive liquid as an example, the methods and suggestions to further improve the measurement accuracy of capacitive liquid level sensor are put forward.

articleTitle: Synchronous Optimization of Key Parameters of Transverse Seismic Isolation System for Asymmetric Cable-stayed Bridge with Unequal Height Towers
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The influence of key parameters of transverse seismic isolation system, which consisted of steel dampers and wind bearings, on transverse seismic response of cable-stayed bridges is investigated in this paper. An asymmetric cable-stayed bridge with unequal height towers is taken an example bridge, and orthogonal test design method is used to set test conditions for synchronous optimization of the key parameters. The results show that significant parameter coupling is observed from internal force of auxiliary pier and left deck end displacement, so synchronous optimization should be considered. Moreover, steel dampers have little effect on the internal force of towers while internal force of auxiliary pier and deck end displacement can be significantly decreased by setting steel dampers.

articleTitle: Motion Posture Recognition Method Based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To solve the problem of differential human motion recognition of different users in human-computer interaction, SVM is used to classify and recognize the motion posture. We use Kinect sensor to capture human motion, generate depth image, and establish three-dimensional human model after processing. Then the target behavior recognition adopts a two-level SVM classifier to map various action signals to the feature space to form a feature vector with a certain dimension. During the process of outputting recognition results, corresponding confidence is output and the motion posture is determined by the change classification of motion features. The experimental results show that this research method uses the invariance and orthogonality of support vector machine to improve the recognition rate of vector optimization to more than 95%. Its the action recognition effect is good, which has better robustness with similar algorithms.

articleTitle: An Improved Gtsam-based Nonlinear Optimization Algorithm in ORBSLAM3
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Autonomous driving and robotics play an important role in smart cities. SLAM technology is the core of its perception module. Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) has become a application hotspot in the field of the urban traffic in recent years. Most SLAM algorithms are time-consuming and thus their real-time performance is difficult to be guarantee. To solve this problem, this paper proposes an improved ORBSLAM3 speeding-up algorithm based on Gtsam(Georgia Tech Smoothing and Mapping). The factor graph optimizer based on Gtsam library is used to describe the local map BA and solve the pose BA to improve computing efficiency. The Experimental results based on Euroc data set show that Gtsam improves the running speed of tracking thread by 13%-15% compared with g2o, and the rmse of absolute track error analysis decrease by 0.21.

articleTitle: MPLS Network Routing Algorithm Based on Network Minimum Cost
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the network congestion and routing conflicts caused by the surge in the number of network access nodes and the variety of services, this paper proposes a routing algorithm based on minimum cost deployed in MPLS networks. The minimum cost routing algorithm uses MPLS technology to obtain the data information of each node's business in the network to calculate a new cost function. According to this cost function, the path of data propagation is planned, and the network resources are allocated in a balanced manner. While improving the utilization rate of network resources, the conflict of route selection between services is avoided, and the possibility of network failures is reduced. This method effectively improves the network performance. The experimental results show that, compared with the traditional SPF routing algorithm, the LCR algorithm can better balance the network load, improve the utilization of resources in the network, and meet the service quality required by the user's business. It is an efficient and simple routing algorithm and has certain research prospects.

articleTitle: Mandarin Emotion Recognition Based on Weighted Fusion Strategegy
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In emotion recognition, different emotion features play different roles in emotion recognition. In order to improve the correct rate of emotion recognition, we modify the equivalent emotion feature weight in the traditional emotion recognition algorithm. Firstly, the weight value is set according to the contribution of each emotional feature to emotion recognition, then the weighting matrix of each modal feature is created, and finally a multimodal emotion recognition model based on feature level fusion and decision level weighted fusion is constructed and verified in CHEAVD data set. The results show that the multimodal emotion recognition model constructed in this paper improves the recognition rate by 5.43% compared with the emotion recognition model with only feature level fusion, and improves the recognition rate by 4.52%, 7.56% and 4.915% respectively compared with other mainstream emotion recognition models.

articleTitle: Research on Speech Emotion Recognition Base on SVM
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Many resources and tools on emotion recognition have been prepared and developed by academia for a long time. Resources are a prerequisite for emotion recognition implementation. This paper reviews the research status of commonly used speech emotion databases in detail. Since the extraction of speech emotion features has a decisive influence on the recognition results, the selection of its features is the top priority of the research. Based on this, this paper proposes a method on speech emotion recognition based on SVM multi-feature fusion. The five features of MFCC, Melspectrogram, Chroma, Tonnetz and Contrast are used for fusion. The experimental results show that the recognition rate of the fusion feature paper proposed in this paper reaches 90.15%. When using the SVM classifier on the emo-db database. It can be concluded that multi-feature fusion has better recognition performance than single feature, and the performance is stable. Finally, the current status and future trends of speech emotion recognition are discussed.

articleTitle: Incorporating Social Tagging for Unified Probabilistic Matrix Factorization Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the development of social network, the information in social network environment is increasing rapidly. It is a hot issue that how to recommend the resources to users according to their interests using big data. In order to improve the quality of recommendation, this paper proposes a unified probability matrix factorization recommendation model called TSRec which integrates social tags. The model uses the information of users, resources and tags of social network, and optimizes the parameters of the training model to provide the best recommendation effect.

articleTitle: Mechanical Characteristics of Long-span Cable-stayed Bridge with large FVDs
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Installation of longitudinal large fluid viscous dampers (FVDs) between the deck and pylon has been widely used in seismic design of long-span cable-stayed bridge. For a long-span cable-stayed bridge, the period of the first-order which mode is deck longitudinal sway is long and far away from predominant period of conventional ground motions. If the seismic design of FVDs mainly targets at effectively decreasing longitudinal displacement of deck and seismic forces of major components of the bridge, FVDs may provide super high damping level to deck longitudinal movement. Under this situation, the effects on mechanical properties of long-span cable-stayed bridge is investigated by modal vibrations. The modal vibrations achieved by applying lst~150th order mode shapes one by one as initial displacement on the bridge in four conditions, namely undamped, only FVDs considered, only system damping considered, both FVDs and system damping considered. Among them, the condition of only FVDs considered is the core since FVDs is the only source of structural damping in this case. By comparison responses under the four conditions, the super high damping phenomenon of longitudinal vibration caused by nonlinear fluid viscous dampers (NFVDs) is demonstrated and that NFVDs has provided non-ignorable supplementary equivalent viscous damping ratio on some nonfirst modal vibrations is illustrated.

articleTitle: Pedestrian indoor inertial navigation Zero-velocity Detector based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the robustness and accuracy of the traditional zero velocity update algorithm in pedestrian indoor navigation and positioning can not be taken into account, this paper proposes a pedestrian indoor inertial navigation algorithm based on LSTM, and designs and verifies the algorithm model according to the actual situation. Based on the classical fixed threshold zero velocity update algorithm, this method uses LSTM neural network to adaptively identify the zero velocity update points of pedestrians at different speeds of normal walking and fast walking. It is not necessary to adjust the threshold repeatedly according to different pedestrian speeds like the fixed threshold algorithm, so as to obtain higher accuracy and better robustness. The experimental results show that under two different speeds, the error of pedestrian indoor navigation and positioning based on LSTM is divided into 3.173m and 4.242m, which is far less than the error of traditional fixed threshold algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on method of Determining Floor Response Spectra for 110kV, 220kV Indoor Substation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In this paper, the floor response spectrum generation method for 110kV, 220kV indoor substation with GIS (Gas Insulated Switchgear) equipment is studied. Based on the theory of response spectrum, the formula of floor response spectrum is proposed by modifying the conventional response spectrum. The formula is described that the seismic response of floor is taken as the new vibration ground to do a seismic analysis of GIS equipment on this floor. In order to verify the applicability of the proposed method, we selected two typical indoor substation projects, generated 30 artificial seismic waves using the standard response spectrum, and directly simulated the seismic response time history curve of GIS equipment by finite element method, and obtained 30 floor response spectrum curves of GIS equipment directly by using time history curve. The floor response spectrum generated by finite element simulation is compared with the floor response spectrum obtained by the method proposed in this paper. The results show that the method proposed in this paper is suitable for seismic analysis of GIS equipment in 110kV, 220kV indoor substation.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation and Analysis of Flutter Derivatives Under Different Wind Attack Angles
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In the numerical simulation of flutter derivatives, the unstructured grid computing model can be adopted and the hybrid grid computing model can be further divided according to the different partition settings of the hybrid grid computing domain. In this paper, the flutter derivatives of thin plates at 0°, 3°, 5° and 7° angles of wind attack areidentified by using the fractional state forced vibration method, and the critical flutter wind speed is calculated by graphical method. The numerical results of flutter derivative and flutter critical wind speed were compared with the experimental results to verify the reliability of the numerical method in identifying flutter derivative at different wind attack angles.

articleTitle: Moving Object Tracking Based on Infrared Thermal Imager and Vision Sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a moving object tracking method that fuses infrared thermal imager and vision data for solving the limitations of single mode image information. First, contour feature matching is realized by the proposed shape context and Hog feature on the basis of foreground detection by Gaussian Mixture Model. Second, the regularization and scaling characteristics are used to reorganize the corresponding relation and estimate the transformation. In order to extend match to the whole shape, a TPS transformation model is established. A regularization method is used to relax the interpolation requirements, and the estimation error is reduced by iteratively reorganizing corresponding relationship and estimating the transformation. Finally, moving objects are determined by adaptive background subtraction. In complex and changeable lighting and meteorological conditions, the application of vision sensor has certain limitations, and multi-sensor fusion can realize information complementarity, this method combines edge and contour feature information, with better fault tolerance, real-time and robustness than a single sensor.

articleTitle: Design of Low Power Radio Energy Transmission Device
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the transmission efficiency of low power radio energy transmission device as much as possible, the optimal design scheme of the system is proposed Starting from the analysis of the basic working principle of wireless energy transmission device, the performance index is defined. It is required to input 15V voltage and output 5V voltage, which can be used for charging portable equipment. The influence of winding material and coil cross-sectional area on electric energy transmission efficiency is studied. The device is mainly composed of driving circuit module, transmitting coil module, receiving coil module and electric energy conversion module. The practical experiment shows that the optimal design scheme has good effect.

articleTitle: Optimal Control Strategy for Charging and Discharging Fluctuation of Composite Energy Storage Considering Dual Evaluation Index of Photovoltaic Access
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the fluctuation of photovoltaic active power affects the stable operation of power grid, a hybrid energy storage smooth output fluctuation control strategy considering photovoltaic double evaluation indexes is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the network calculus method is used to decompose the photovoltaic active power signal, and the gray correlation degree is used to reconstruct the power into high-frequency and low-frequency components, so as to obtain the command of smooth output fluctuation of high-frequency supercapacitor and low-frequency battery. Then, the moving average filter smoothing curve is used as the charge and discharge target reference power to obtain the charge and discharge power command of the hybrid energy storage command. The hybrid energy storage battery pack composed of battery and supercapacitor is used to smooth the output fluctuation on the time scale of 5 minutes, and the single battery pack composed of supercapacitor is used to smooth the output fluctuation on the time scale of 1 minute. The smoothness tracks the smooth output fluctuation, and the priority smoothing output fluctuation strategy of energy storage system with different time scales is obtained. Finally, taking a photovoltaic power station as an example, various photovoltaic power decomposition methods and different evaluation indexes are comprehensively compared to verify the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of wind field characteristics at bridge sites in flat and gorge terrains under the moving thunderstorm downburst
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To compare the effects of the moving thunderstorm downburst on the wind field characteristics at bridge sites in flat terrain and gorge terrain, numerical simulations were conducted on the wind field characteristics both in the flat and gorge terrains under the moving thunderstorm downburst by using the SST k-ω turbulence model combined with the impinging jet simulation method. Then, the distributions of wind speed and wind attack angle along the bridge girder in these two terrains were compared and analyzed. The results showed that during the motion of the thunderstorm downburst, the wind speeds at the mid-span point of the bridge girder are relatively minimum in flat and gorge terrains, and the farther away from the mid-span point, the greater the wind speed. In the flat terrain, the values of wind attack angle at the monitoring points are mainly negative, while in the gorge terrain, most of the wind attack angles are positive.

articleTitle: Safety path planning of cargo size based on improved ant colony algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve potential safety problems that mobile robots can’t choose the best path real-time actual size according to the actual size of shipping goods and obstacles . This paper puts forward a new pheromone updating method based on ant colony algorithm, which set penalty factor to consider the influence of different sizes of goods transported by mobile robots and adjust the pheromone concentration adaptively. Firstly. This method could avoid the blind search of ant colony algorithm in the initial iteration by using Dijkstra algorithm to determine the initial path. In addition. This method improve the global planning ability of the algorithm in the middle iteration. After accurate division of raster map, the real-time penalty factor is formulated according to the actual size of mobile robot to improve the real-time pheromone concentration. At last, the experiment results shows that the path planning security of the algorithm has a great improved, and realize the function of updating the global path in real time according to the actual size of the cargo.

articleTitle: Identification of Prestress Loss Through Bridge-Vehicle Interaction Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Loss of prestress is one of key reasons for the structural deficiency of prestressed bridges. Existence of prestress in bridges affects the dynamic responses of both bridges and vehicles traveling over them. The focus of this paper is to investigate the effect of prestress and identify prestress loss in prestressed bridge through bridge-vehicle interaction analysis. To fulfill that, a new bridge-vehicle model with consideration of prestress effect is created through the principle of virtual works, where the bridge is modeled as a beam with eccentric prestress and the vehicle is represented by a half-vehicle model with 4 degrees of freedom. The correctness and accuracy of the model are validated with literature results. Based on the created model, numerical simulation has been conducted and it is found that prestress has a high impact on the maximum vehicle vertical acceleration, which may serve as a good indication for detecting the prestress loss.

articleTitle: Design of dynamic monitoring and anti-theft system for port commodity vehicle’s moving track based on Internet of things
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Commodity vehicle import and export business is a very important business in many ports in China. The theft of transportation goods happens from time to time, and there is a great risk of stolen goods vehicles with large value. Due to the low level of information technology in many ports in China, there are still many paper bills to be transmitted, which can not real-time grasp the moving track of commercial vehicles, which makes the risk of vehicle theft very high. In this study, a kind of moving track monitoring system is designed for the whole process of commercial vehicle from entering port to leaving port, so as to master the track of commodity vehicle in real time and prevent theft. The system is based on Internet of things(IOT) technology, uses RFID technology to uniquely identify vehicle information, and connects handheld devices with management system data through WebService interface. The system organically combines IOT hardware and port production service system. IOT hardware is responsible for setting virtual card port, and production service system is responsible for data receiving and displaying real-time data generated by IOT hardware. This system can not only reduce the delivery of paper bills and improve the operation efficiency of the port, but also can dynamically monitor the moving track of vehicles in the port, which greatly reduces the risk of theft, with strong practicality and operability.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Large Volume Hydration Heat Effect of Anchor Foundation for Suspension Bridge
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The anchor anchor foundation of a suspension bridge with the shape of 3-story steps is large volume concrete with the dimensions of 62 m (length) × 55 m (width) × 15 m (height), and in order to avoid temperature cracks caused by the significant hydration heat effect of concrete during construction, concrete with low hydration heat effect is used, and the finite element analysis model of anchor foundation is established by using the finite element software MIDAS. Through the sensitivity analysis of the parameters related to the cooling water pipe that affects the hydration heat effect, the arrangement of the cooling water pipe and the selection of related parameters are optimized, and the peak temperature and maximum tensile stress of each layer of concrete in the anchor foundation with and without the cooling water pipe are calculated. The results show that the use of low-heat cement ratio and optimized cooling water pipe arrangement and parameters for construction control can significantly reduce the peak temperature and maximum principal stresses inside the mass concrete, effectively avoid harmful temperature cracks in the structure during construction, and ensure the safety of the mass anchor foundation.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Hydraulic System of Aircraft Landing Gear Based on CNN-SVM
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty of extracting fault features on the aircraft landing gear hydraulic system, traditional feature extraction methods rely heavily on expert knowledge, and the accuracy of fault diagnosis is difficult to guarantee. This paper combined convolutional neural network (CNN) and support vector machine classification algorithm (SVM) to propose a fault diagnosis model suitable for aircraft landing gear hydraulic system. The diagnosis model adopted the one-dimensional multi-channel CNN network structure, took the original pressure signal of multiple nodes as input, adaptively extracts the feature value of the pressure signal through CNN, and built a multi-feature fusion layer to realize the feature fusion of the pressure signal of each node. Finally, input the fused features into the SVM classifier to complete the fault classification. In order to verify the proposed fault diagnosis model, a typical aircraft landing gear hydraulic system simulation model was built based on AMESim, and several typical fault types such as hydraulic pump leakage, actuator leakage, selector valve clogging and accumulator failure were simulated, and corresponding Fault type data set, and use overlapping sample segmentation for data enhancement. Experiments show that the diagnosis accuracy of the proposed fault diagnosis algorithm can reach 99.25%, which can realize the adaptive extraction of the fault features of the aircraft landing gear hydraulic system, and the features after multi-dimensional fusion have better discrimination, compared with traditional feature extraction methods more effective and more accurate.

articleTitle: Comparative studies on Structural Damage Detection using different kinds of Objective Functions based on Modal Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to investigate the ability of different objective functions based on modal data for SDD problems, six objective functions are defined and a comparison study is presented in this paper. To make a fair comparison, a quantified index name damage vector consistency is defined to describe the consistency between the identified damage vector factor and the assume one. Simply-supported beam with 10 finite elements is simulated which provides modal data generation and damage cases simulation. The percentage of DVC equaling to 100% in the all 100 times is also calculated which shows the objective function based on MTMAC is the best one for SDD.

articleTitle: Cloud computing network intrusion risk detection method under large-scale DDoS attack
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low sensitivity and poor F value of comprehensive index in traditional detection methods, a cloud computing network intrusion risk detection method based on Naive Bayesian algorithm is proposed to detect the risk under large-scale DDoS attacks. Under DDoS attack, linear chain conditional random field is used to analyze the characteristics of cloud computing network intrusion risk, and a feature selection algorithm based on maximum correlation or minimum redundancy is proposed; The naive Bayesian algorithm is used to reduce the dimension of cloud computing network intrusion risk, and the Bayesian optimal classifier is introduced to realize cloud computing network intrusion risk detection. The experimental results show that when the number of attacks increases, compared with the traditional method, the improved method has high sensitivity and improved comprehensive index, which has certain advantages.

articleTitle: A cover hole repair method based on improved k-means and genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the uncertainty of the location of virtual repair nodes in Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) changes the topology of the network and causes the network to lose connectivity, a coverage hole repair optimization method based on improved k-means genetic algorithm is proposed. Firstly, use the hole modeling analysis to determine the position of the virtual repair node, and cluster the sensor nodes in the hole area according to the improved k-means algorithm. Secondly, use the improved genetic algorithm to find the shortest path in each cluster in parallel. Finally, the minimum distance principle is used to integrate each cluster into a whole, and the shortest path in the cavity area is found, and the sensing data in the cavity area is transmitted and communicated along the path within a certain period of time. The simulation results show that it is feasible to apply the improved k-means genetic algorithm to the coverage hole repair. Through multiple iterations of the algorithm, the shortest path between repair nodes in the hole can be found to achieve network connectivity, save node energy, and extend the network life cycle.

articleTitle: Modeling of Concrete Carbonization Process based on Cellular Automata
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Concrete carbonation is one of the important factors affecting the durability of concrete structures. It is of great significance to study the transmission process of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> in concrete. Combined with the principle of cellular automata and the transmission mechanism of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> in concrete, a cellular automata model for simulating the transmission process of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> in concrete is proposed. The reliability of the model is verified by comparing with the experimental results and the calculation results of analytical method. The results show that the simulation results of cellular automata model are in good agreement with the measured values and the calculated results of analytical method, and the maximum deviation is no more than 1%. The concentration of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> in the section decreases with the increase of depth and increases with the increase of service time. The carbonization depth of chamfered area is 1.3 times that of the ordinary area. The proposed model provides a new calculation method for the durability analysis of concrete structures.

articleTitle: Design of logistics center location method based on supply chain big data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: For the location selection of logistics centers, there has always been an inaccurate analysis of supply chain data, resulting in low location accuracy. This paper proposes a logistics center location method based on supply chain big data. First, the Euclidean distance is used to calculate the similarity of the supply chain data. Secondly, the supply chain data is predicted through the Markov chain. Based on this, the objective function of the location of the logistics center can be established by combining the inertia weight. Clustering is carried out to determine the location of the logistics center, and finally the experimental analysis is carried out. The experimental results show that the improved method has high traffic convenience and can effectively improve the location accuracy of the logistics center.

articleTitle: Research on Network Performance and Availability Modeling Based on Data Link
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: As the basis of information war, military network plays a vital role in the development of war. Network availability is one of the most important performance of military network construction and operation. It is also an important index to measure the quality of system structure design and system performance stability. Therefore, based on the analysis of the factors affecting the availability of military network, starting from the basic concept of network availability and using Markov random process theory, this paper puts forward the Markov model of multi state repairable system of communication network, and analyzes and calculates the delay and throughput of military network system in Link16 data link. It provides some references for the development of military network in the future.

articleTitle: Non-contact Measuring Instrument for Liquid Level Based on STM32 MCU
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: When measuring the liquid level in industrial production, the contact measuring instrument isn’t applicable, because the measured liquid is often flammable, explosive and volatile. Therefore, a measuring method is needed to realize the non-contact measurement for liquid level in the container. At present, the main core technologies of non-contact measurement for liquid level are radar liquid level measurement technology, laser liquid level measurement technology, ultrasonic liquid level measurement technology and other advanced technologies. Ultrasonic liquid level measurement technology can truly reach our goal due to ultrasonic wave's good directivity, strong penetration ability and avoiding direct contact between the liquid level indicator and the liquid medium. The non-contact measuring instrument for liquid level with large range, low blind zone and high quality is formed by studying the principle of ultrasonic ranging technology further and optimizing the scheme.

articleTitle: Research on Protection Switching Time of IP over OTN
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To solve the problem of large capacity and high speed data transmission, IP over OTN network is widely used. To ensure the normal operation of IP business, the protection switching policy (the method to change network from active state to standby state when the network fails) is generally configured However, the traditional protection switching policy is configured based an independent IP network or OTN network, the protection switching policy would fails if it based on IP over OTN network. The protection switching time would last too long to result in IP business interruption when the IP over OTN network fails. That is to say, the traditional configuration of protection switching policy is not properly. To solve above problem, the relationship between protection switching policy configuration and network topology is researched. And an optimized policy configuration method under dual-routing network structure is proposed in this paper. This method avoids conflicts between transport layer policy and network layer policy. And this method simply changes the network connection, with no need to add additional devices and no need to adjust the protection switching policy. Experiment shows that the method can reduce the protection switching time significantly and ensure IP business uninterrupted.

articleTitle: Joint 2D DOA and Polarization Estimation Based on V-Shaped Polarization Sensitive Array
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In this paper, a V-shaped polarization sensitive array is constructed by crossed electric dipoles and the corresponding snapshot model is built. On this basis, a joint estimation algorithm of DOA and polarization is proposed. Monte-Carlo simulation results show that the proposed parameter estimation method has the advantages of high estimation accuracy, strong resolution and low computation.

articleTitle: Detecting of the Crack in the Joint of Precast Segmental Bridge
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Due to construction errors and disturbances, some crack have been found at the epoxy joints of PCSBs during construction or operation stage. These defects will affect the structural behavior, safety and durability of the bridge. An NDT method using active sensing with piezoceramic based smart aggregate (SA) to detect the crack and in the epoxy joint of PCSBs was proposed in this paper, and the effectiveness and feasibility was verified by experiment in the present work. By comparing the collected voltage signals, PSD energy and WEPI under different healthy states, it is shown that, the test results are closely related to the the length of the crack in the joint. It is demonstrated that the proposed active monitoring method with piezoceramic based SAs provides an effective approach to detect and monitor the crack in the joint of PCSB

articleTitle: Research and Application of Intelligent Diagnosis of Health status of Relay Protection Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The status of relay protection equipment is an important work in operation management. Based on the real-time operation condition of relay protection, historical operation data, equipment operation years, historical maintenance data and other information related to the operation status of relay protection, a multi-dimensional mixed data model of relay protection is constructed. According to the requirements of the guidelines for condition based maintenance of relay protection, the intelligent state assessment algorithm and function for effective analysis and evaluation of the operation status of relay protection are studied, The intelligent diagnosis of the health status of relay protection equipment and the trend prediction of hidden faults are realized. Finally, an actual function display page of the intelligent substation relay protection online monitoring system is displayed to verify the correctness of the method.

articleTitle: Research on mobile real time monitoring technology based on Intelligent mountaineering stick
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In this paper, the threshold judgment method of acceleration and angular velocity is used to determine the guardian's body posture, and the adaptive filtering method is used to process the pulse wave, which can effectively judge the abnormal body posture and heart rate data of the ward and send out alarm information. The fall detection and heart rate data detection are designed and tested. According to the acceleration and angular velocity information compared with the set threshold, the attitude of intelligent crutches is detected and judged. In the aspect of heart rate detection, the adaptive filtering algorithm is used to make the obtained heart rate data more accurate. The guardian can set the normal heart rate range according to the physical condition of the guardian.

articleTitle: Research on Fatigue Driving Detection Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To accurately detect fatigue driving behaviour, this paper proposes an intelligent detection model that combines face detection, facial key points localization and fatigue decision. This model takes video frame sequences as input, first detect faces by YOLOv4-tiny network, then make facial key points localization by PFLD network, and finally determine fatigue status by a decision model. To solve the problem of insufficient detection accuracy, the ESA attention module is introduced into the YOLOv4-tiny model, and the ASPP module is introduced into the PFLD network. Experiments prove that the optimized model can effectively improve the accuracy of face detection and facial key points localization. Based on the facial key points, refined features of eyes and mouth can be extracted for integrated fatigue decision, and an accuracy rate of 94.28% is achieved.

articleTitle: Moving Target Location Method Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the defects of existing moving target detection algorithms, a moving target location method based on machine vision is proposed in this paper. Firstly, we adopt a target detection method combining background difference and inter frame difference, and provide the extraction and formal description of moving target features. Then, based on the accurate detection of moving targets in video images, an adaptive Camshift algorithm is designed to establish the tracking target template, and it improves the shortcomings of such algorithm which is sensitive to color and illumination. The experimental results show that the strategy can track moving targets quickly and effectively, and it has good real-time performance.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of concrete retaining blocks for bridge based on ABAQUS
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to deeply study the functional feasibility and seismic performance of the new prefabricated retaining wall, the finite element models of different retaining walls are established and compared with the test results. The effects of structural materials and structural forms on the seismic failure mode of retaining wall are discussed. The results show that the established finite element numerical model can well simulate the damage state of different types of concrete blocks in laboratory tests. The new post tensioned unbonded precast UHPC block can meet the requirements of higher lateral bearing capacity, displacement capacity and self resetting capacity at the same time.

articleTitle: Construction Monitoring Platform with BIM+IoT+GIS for Xintian Yangtze River Bridge
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In view of the low degree of informatization and long feedback period of traditional long-span suspension bridge construction monitoring, relying on Xintian Yangtze River Bridge, using BIM model as the information carrier, while integrating GIS and IOT technology, combined with monitoring business needs, build construction monitoring visualization The software platform provides various environmental structure status information in the process of suspension bridge construction monitoring in an intuitive and three-dimensional form to all participants, providing a reference for the realization of intelligent monitoring and the application of BIM in suspension bridge construction monitoring.

articleTitle: Positioning error detection method of Beidou navigation system in Internet of things based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The introduction of Beidou system into the Internet of things can greatly improve the management efficiency of Internet of things equipment, but it also puts forward higher requirements for the positioning accuracy of the Internet of things. However, the existing positioning and detection systems have the problems of low detection efficiency and low detection accuracy. In order to solve the above problems, this paper designs a positioning error detection method of Beidou System in the Internet of things based on cloud computing. In the hardware part, it adopts the form of boom and DSP, and realizes data exchange with the help of 4G communication module. In the software part, the error detection architecture and data forwarding scheme based on cloud computing are designed. After calculating the ephemeris error, the carrier phase periodic jump technique is used to detect the positioning error. The system test results show that the designed system can effectively detect the positioning error of Beidou navigation system in the Internet of things, the detection efficiency is improved by 61.72%, and the detection accuracy is high.

articleTitle: Image Design of E-commerce Brand Logo Based on Visual Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of feature extraction and classification retrieval in brand logo image design, an e-commerce brand logo image design scheme based on visual feature extraction is proposed in this paper. We first study the relevant theories of visual communication and Internet e-commerce brand design. Then, according to the spatial distribution characteristics of image color, a novel representation method based on entropy is put forward and it is used to provide a color feature extraction strategy through sparse classification. Finally, the main procedures of logo image design and retrieval based on a series of processes such as feature extraction, vector classification and design retrieval are provided. The experimental results show that the extracted image comprehensive features can realize image retrieval since the effective combination of semantic and visual features in image classification. It realizes the classification design of brand logo, and has better retrieval effect than the color histogram method.

articleTitle: Signal Detection for Ambient Backscatter Communications Based on DDPG
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In this paper, a modified model of the ambient backscatter communication (AmBC) using reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) is built. On this basis, the optimization problem of solving the maximum value of generalized relative channel difference for signal detection is derived. The optimization solution based on deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) is proposed. Monte-Carlo simulation results show that the proposed optimization method has the advantages of high gains and fast convergence rate.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Time difference Control System for Signal Lamp Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In this paper, based on the BP neural network, a signal light intelligent time difference control system model is established. The number of vehicles in the two opposite lanes is used as the input, and the difference time of the traffic signal is used as the output. A three-layer neural network model with two inputs and one output is created. Using MATLAB's neural network toolbox to conduct research, after training and test verification, the signal light intelligent time difference control system model based on BP neural network can intelligently decide a more suitable traffic light time difference according to the indicators, and it can be used for road traffic at similar intersections. Grooming has better applicability.

articleTitle: Study on the Anti-overturning Performance and Improving Technology of Continuous Bridges with Single-column Piers Subjected to Extreme Vertical Eccentric Loads
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Continuous girder bridges with single-column piers are widely used in urban viaducts and highways because of their advantages containing the beautiful type, space occupation and the full vision. However, the overturning resistance of continuous girder bridges with single-column piers is weak, and the overturning problem subjected to the eccentric load of heavy vehicles is more prominent, which may cause great loss of life and property. The anti-overturning stability of continuous girder bridges with single-column piers subjected to extreme vertical eccentric load is studied by establishing finite element model, and the influencing factors of anti-overturning performance of such as type of bridges are taken into research. The results show that the safety factor against overturning of continuous bridges with single-column piers may not meet the design requirement. Auxiliary columns are recommended to be added to the middle single-column piers, and the anti-overturning coefficient of the bridge subjected to the most unfavorable partial load can be significantly improved.

articleTitle: Ant Colony Algorithm Optimization for Software Defined Network Load Balancing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To solve the problems of low efficiency and poor flexibility caused by the traditional load balancing methods which can not obtain the statistical data of network devices effectively or the load balancing influence factors, this paper proposes a joint path server ant colony optimization algorithm considering path level and server level jointly. The server balance module collects the performance index of the server, grasps the status of the server in time, and calculates the weight of the server by using the dynamic algorithm based on the server performance. In the process of rerouting, this paper adopts an optimized ACO algorithm, which changes the search rules of the ordinary algorithm. The path searched by ants is filtered by the dynamic load balance value to determine the optimal path. The simulation results show that compared with the traditional load balancing control algorithm, the proposed scheme has better quality of service. It can achieve greater throughput and lower packet loss rate, which also shows excellent management and utilization of network resources.

articleTitle: Hybrid simulation of rockfalls impact on bridge structure based on OpenSees-MATLAB-VecTor2
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Compared with the traditional experiment, the finite element (FE) simulation method is more cost-effective and more efficient. Hence, it is widely used to analyze the impact response of the structure. However, single structural analysis software is often only useful for some specific problems, and no one can be applied to solve all types of structural problems. A software that is widely used to analyze the impact response of structures, i.e., LS-DYNA, has been proved to be flawed in capturing the shear behavior of certain structures. Taking into account the shortcomings of the existing analysis software, this study has developed a hybrid simulation method based on OpenSees-MATLAB-VecTor2 to analyze the dynamic behavior of the bridge structure under rockfall impacts. The modeling details of the hybrid model are introduced in detail in this study. The single-machine model is built to compare the damage of the bridge column under the impact of rockfalls with the hybrid model. The results show that the impact point displacement of the impacted column simulated by the hybrid model is greater than that of the single-machine model because the hybrid model can capture the shear damage behavior of the bridge column.

articleTitle: Partial Discharge Defect Detection Method of Insulation Equipment Based on Knowledge Map
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of insulation state detection of power equipment, an intelligent method for power defect information processing using knowledge map technology is proposed in this paper. By optimizing the general process of constructing knowledge map, this scheme proposes to use graph search to identify defects and record errors. To improve the utilization of data and mine the related information affecting the insulation state of equipment, Neo4j's power big data modeling method is used to store the text data of insulation state of power equipment based on graph database. The experimental results show that the insulation equipment defect detection based on graph database and knowledge map has high recognition efficiency and meets the real-time requirements of the system.

articleTitle: Prediction model of seismic response for continuous girder bridge based on machine learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of seismic response prediction of continuous girder bridge, this paper proposes a new prediction model of seismic response for continuous girder bridge based on machine learning. Firstly, 927 bridge samples are generated by Latin hypercube sampling algorithm; Then, through machine learning, the prediction model of seismic response of continuous girder bridge is established. Compared with the linear regression, SGD regression and ridge regression algorithm under specific ground motion load, the accuracy of new machine learning prediction model of of seismic response for continuous girder bridge is verified.

articleTitle: Damage test and monitoring of reinforced concrete (RC) beams under four-point bending
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The damage monitoring of non-corroded and corroded reinforced concrete (RC) beams subjected to four-point bending is reported in this paper. Acoustic emission(AE) technique was applied to investigate the damage growth and the failure mechanism of the RC beams. The results show that the trend of the fractured state of RC beams at different loading stages can be determined from the trend of the Ib-value curve. Compared with uncorroded and lightly corroded beams, severity corroded beams have higher maximumIb-value curves and more active acoustic emission signals. The corrosion of steel reinforcement obviously accelerates the initiation and propagation of cracks in RC beams under four-point bending tests.

articleTitle: Identification and Difference Analysis of Motorcycle Drivers' Driving Style Based on Natural Driving Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to deeply understand the driving behavior characteristics of different motorcycle drivers, based on the natural driving data of Shaanxi Chebaidu Motorcycle Company, five types of bad driving behaviors are used as driving behaviors: sharp acceleration, sharp deceleration, sharp right turn, left sharp turn and speeding tendency. The style characteristic index, based on the SOM-K-Means clustering calculation, divides the driving style of drivers into three categories: cautious, mild, and aggressive, and the corresponding driver proportions are 88%, 10%, and 1% of the sample drivers, respectively. The statistical analysis of drivers with different driving styles after clustering shows that the SOM-K-Means algorithm can effectively realize the clustering of drivers with different driving styles.

articleTitle: Research on application software operation fault diagnosis method based on big data mining
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The current fault diagnosis methods can only diagnose whether the software has a fault, but can’t correlate the fault cause with the fault performance, the diagnosis accuracy is not high, and it is difficult to meet the demand of fault diagnosis with the surge of operation response. In order to optimize the operation management level of application software and improve the fault diagnosis accuracy of application software, the application software operation fault diagnosis method based on big data mining will be studied. The data is preprocessed according to the dynamic changes of data flow when the application software is running. The parallel optimized FP_Growth algorithm is used to mine the association relation of the running data. A high-dimensional clustering algorithm is used to diagnose software running faults with mined association rules as initial clustering conditions. The simulation results show that the accuracy of fault diagnosis is improved by at least 25.1% after the application of data mining, and the efficiency of fault diagnosis is improved to some extent. Moreover, the proposed method is suitable for different types of application software.

articleTitle: A smart contract approach to access control based on distributed identities and roles
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the continuous development of digital communication in Internet of Things(IOT) and the demand of IOT for advanced interoperability and collaboration, organizations and entities directly need to interact with data. Access control technology is the key to current data protection and system management. In this paper, we details the method framework, contract design, and execution process of the DID-based blockchain access control, and analyze for data leakage, security issues, data storage and system complexity in the current solution. In order to solve the current problems, this paper combines blockchain technology with identity access control scheme based on the application of distributed identification; Secondly, a detailed of DID mark and smart contract interaction mechanism are design. Finally, an implementation scheme is proposed on this scheme combined with the IoT scenario and is demonstrated to run in a real scenario. The usability, security and efficiency of the framework are evaluated in simulation tests and performance.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment Strategy for Distribution Network Operation considering New Power Access
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: According to the uncertainty of distributed generation power and electric vehicle charging power, a new energy distribution network operation evaluation strategy is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the reliability evaluation index of distribution network with multiple operation states is constructed according to various output states of distributed generation. Then, with the help of Monte Carlo simulation method, the statistics of specific examples are carried out to obtain the time and frequency indexes of reliability. Finally, the effectiveness of the model and method is verified by a specific example in MATLAB. The results show that the effectiveness of the model and method can more accurately evaluate the voltage offset risk of the distribution network with new energy, and the wind solar complementary power supply system can better improve the power supply reliability of the system.

articleTitle: Design and Validation of a Wireless Sensing System for Inclination Measurement
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Structural health monitoring (SHM) is of critical importance to ensuring safety of civil infrastructure systems. Measuring physical parameters such as inclination angles can provide insights in identifying and locating subtle structural damages, and thus help to evaluate health conditions of structures. With rapid development of wireless communication technologies, wireless sensing networks enable a low-cost and flexible solution compared to conventional cable-based SHM systems. In this paper, a prototype wireless sensing system for measuring inclination of structures is proposed. The sensing node is designed using low-cost electronic components in the market. Long range (LoRa) technology is adopted to offer long-range wireless communication with low power consumption. To obtain reliable inclination measurement, a sensor fusion algorithm is implemented to fully exploit the advantages of both gyroscopes and accelerometers. Laboratory tests are conducted to investigate the performance of the proposed wireless inclination sensing system.

articleTitle: Design of mechanical chain drive based on particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the control ability and guiding ability of the in-wheel motor steering transmission mechanical chain transmission, and to improve the transmission efficiency of the in-wheel motor steering transmission mechanical chain transmission, a control method of the in-wheel motor steering transmission mechanical chain transmission is proposed. First, build a model of the layered control architecture for the active gear alignment of the hub motor steering drive mechanical chain drive, and use the adaptive four-wheel torque optimization distribution method to realize the hub motor steering drive mechanical chain drive, the front wheel angle, and the additional yaw moment drive, and build the hub motor The space block tracking control law of the steering drive mechanical chain transmission adopts adaptive trajectory tracking and yaw stability coordinated adaptive control method to realize the mechanical chain transmission and spatial parameter identification of the wheel hub motor steering drive, and optimize the particle swarm through the combination of fuzzy tracking control The algorithm establishes a four-wheel torque optimal distribution model, optimizes the wheel hub motor steering drive mechanical chain transmission, so as to achieve path optimization and convergence control in the process of wheel hub motor steering drive mechanical chain transmission torque output control. The simulation results show that the method is robust and adaptive to the mechanical chain transmission control of the steering drive of the in-wheel motor.

articleTitle: A Radar classification system based on Gaussian NB
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Radar recognition has gradually been widely used in daily life, especially in target recognition target classification has a good development prospect. With the rapid development of deep learning, a new material object classification system appears, and a radar classification system based on GaussianNB is proposed. We use radar to identify air,books, hands, knives and plastic boxes.
