By labeling the returned radar signals and conducting supervised training on them, classification models can be obtained and tested using these radar signals. The accuracy of GaussianNB algorithm is 96.36%. However, the accuracy of KNN algorithm is 92.14%, and the accuracy of gradient elevation decision tree is only 88.92%. This shows that GaussianNB based radar subsystem is more effective and accurate.

articleTitle: Finite Element Simulation of UHPC Rectangular Beam Bending Test
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In this paper, four kinds of unreinforced UHPC rectangular beams with different steel fiber content are tested under static load, and the mechanical properties of UHPC rectangular beams are discussed, and the finite element model of UHPC rectangular beams is established. By comparing the test results with the finite element simulation results, the rationality of the finite element modeling method is verified.

articleTitle: Research on Two Wheel Balancing Vehicle Based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In today's society, with the rapid development of e-commerce and the continuous development and growth of express and takeout industries, single transportation has become a very thorny problem. The emergence of balancing vehicle has alleviated this pressure to a great extent. However, the balancing vehicle in the market today has a variety of design problems and security risks, and its function is also relatively simple. Combined with the realizability of the research and the market demand, this paper designs an intelligent balancing vehicle based on STM32. This design adopts sensing technology, driving technology, intelligent identification technology and wireless communication technology, and controls the attitude of the balancing vehicle through PID algorithm to realize smooth operation. The balancing vehicle is equipped with chips of different functional modules and integrated into a multifunctional intelligent balancing vehicle including balanced walking, wireless communication, remote control, follow up, speed measurement, load and so on, which has important research value and significance.

articleTitle: Classification of E-commerce Big Data Based on Iterative Fuzzy Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To address the problems of low recursion efficiency and high redundancy in data classification under the background of current e-commerce big data, this paper proposes a big data classification algorithm based on artificial intelligence. The algorithm adopts the fast Spark architecture, and by setting a vertical sequence controlled according to the data jurisdiction dimension, the efficiency of data mining can be improved to a large extent. The proposed algorithm is simulated and verified by using tourism e-commerce data. The results show that the algorithm takes a short time and has high accuracy in data classification.

articleTitle: Fast Fuzzy C-means Clustering Method for Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Fuzzy C-means (FCM) clustering algorithm is widely used in automatic image segmentation, but the standard FCM algorithm has the problems of large computation and slow computation speed. This paper improves the FCM algorithm, A fast FCM image segmentation algorithm (FFCM) is proposed. The algorithm maps the image from the pixel space to its gray histogram feature space. On this basis, the membership function is improved by making full use of the neighborhood characteristics of pixels. Experimental results show that the algorithm can segment the image quickly and effectively and has good anti-noise capability.

articleTitle: A LSTM-based Sentiment Analysis Network on Classifying Natural Language Comments
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Machine learning techniques, especially deep learning, are currently widely studied in the sentiment analysis task. Automatically classifying natural language comments to positive or negative is an essential and challenging task. In this paper, the sentiment analysis network based on LSTM is utilized to predict human emotion via natural language. Firstly, several variants of LSTM networks are introduced and developed. Then, the proposed network is designed to be able to inference and classify five levels of rating via human comments as input. In addition, a movie reviews benchmark dataset is utilized to evaluate our proposed network with other baseline algorithms. Finally, the results demonstrate promising and competitive performance against other classical methods with the accuracy of 0.8743.

articleTitle: ATO Adaptive Robust Control Algorithm for High-speed Train in Strong Wind
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The operation of high-speed trains in strong wind environment is a strong coupling and highly nonlinear process, and with the increase of wind speed, this characteristic gradually increases, which seriously affects the safety of high-speed trains. In order to overcome the time-varying parameters and nonlinear uncertainty of high-speed train operation process model under strong wind environment, an adaptive robust control algorithm is proposed in this paper, based on the Lyapunov stability theory, an ATO adaptive robust controller for high-speed trains is designed. The controller can overcome the adverse effects of parameter variations and wind disturbance, and ensure the robust global asymptotic stability and good tracking dynamic performance of the system. The simulation results verify the feasibility of the controller.

articleTitle: Design of Visual Servo Control System for 6-DOF Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the manipulator arm cannot adapt to the change of the external environment in the complex working environment, a servo control system design of the 6-DOF manipulator based on binocular vision was proposed. The D-H modeling method is used to model and solve the kinematics of the manipulator, and target coordinates are provided for the manipulator through binocular vision and hand-eye calibration, thus realize the function of visual servo system. Finally, the accuracy of binocular measurement is verified and the autonomous grasping action is completed.

articleTitle: Loss prediction model of distribution network based on quantitative data calculation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of distribution network loss prediction model, this paper proposes a loss prediction model of distribution network based on quantitative data calculation. Firstly, the load imbalance coefficient, which represents the degree of system load imbalance, is defined and combined with the theoretical calculation of network loss to simulate the generation of system network loss numerical data; Then, the correlation between load level, imbalance level and total network loss is qualitatively analyzed, and a deep confidence network (DBN) is constructed to learn the sample data and obtain the implicit representation of the correlation between characteristic quantities. The simulation results show that DBN can effectively describe the complex mapping relationship between load imbalance coefficient, load apparent power and total network loss, and can quickly and accurately predict the network loss of distribution network.

articleTitle: Impact assessment model of tunnel construction on tunnel operation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to accurately evaluate the impact of tunnel construction on tunnel operation, a new impact evaluation model of tunnel construction on tunnel operation is established in this paper. Firstly, the three-dimensional models of paihuadong tunnel and Mingyueshan tunnel of Shanghai Chengdu Railway are established; Then, the excavation of the left and right lines of Mingyueshan tunnel is simulated, and the change of structural internal force is evaluated; Finally, based on the simulation results, the influence model of tunnel construction on tunnel operation is established. The results show that the model can accurately reflect the impact of tunnel construction on tunnel operation.

articleTitle: The vehicle-bridge interaction influence on suspender of arch bridge under various driving parameters
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The fatigue durability of suspenders is the key problem in the operation and maintenance stage of the bridge. Based on the research background of a long-span tied arch bridge in China, the theoretical model of vehicle-bridge- interaction (VBI) is established. The numerical model of the bridge was established to carry out VBI analysis. Then, the influence of road roughness, speed, transverse lane and vehicle type are analyzed, the parameters that should be considered during the analysis of VIB were determined. Finally, the random traffic simulation program was adopted to simulate the traffic parameters to calculate the stress spectrum of suspenders under different driving parameters. In addition, the rain flow count method was utilized to count the fatigue stress amplitude and its cyclic number. By combination S–N curve with Palmgren-Miner cumulative damage criterion, the fatigue life of uncorroded suspenders and corroded suspenders was estimated. The results show that the fatigue life of suspenders considering corrosion or not are 100 years and 20 years, respectively and the difference of driving parameters of vehicles should be fully considered during the analysis.

articleTitle: Vibration characters and parameter analysis of curved steel-concrete composite beams
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to study the free vibration characters of the curved steel-concrete composite beams, the free vibration model experiments were conducted on six curved steel-concrete composite box beams with the curve radius and diaphragms quantity as parameters. The spectrum of vibration waveform was analyzed by DASP VIO software for each beam, and the former three orders of the vibration frequencies and vibration modes were obtained. At the same time, the finite element model was employed for each beam by using ANSYS software, and the numerical results were satisfied well with the test data. Both the experimental and numerical results indicate that, with the decrease of the curve radius, the first and the second order of the vertical bending frequency all descent, but the second order of torsional frequency has little change; with the increase of the shear connection degree, the frequency of each order all express a raising trend; the diaphragms quantity has little influence on the free vibration frequency of the curved composite beams.

articleTitle: Study on Image Caption Generation Model with Improved Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The image caption generation task uses computer vision technology to automatically complete the image target recognition, and then uses the machine translation model to express the content of the image into a natural language, which combines the research directions of the two fields of computer vision and natural language processing. In recent years, the image caption generation model is based on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), but this model suffers from inaccurate visual feature selection and slow training speed. In response to this problem, this paper proposes an image caption generation model based on improved attention mechanism and long short-term memory (LSTM) network. The model uses Vgg19 and Resnet101 in the convolutional neural network as feature extraction networks, and introduces improved the attention mechanism improves the evaluation index of image caption generation compared with the previous attention model. This article uses the public data sets Flickr8K and Flickr8k_cn (Flickr8K Chinese data set marked by native Chinese speakers) for training, and uses a variety of evaluation indicators (BLEU, ROUGE_L, CIDEr, METEOR) to verify the model. The experimental results show that, compared with the traditional attention mechanism, the improved attention mechanism image caption generation model in this paper has a significant improvement in accuracy, and it is better than the traditional model in the four evaluation indicators.

articleTitle: Analysis of Data Characteristics of Vacant Housing Rate Based on Grey Correlation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to study objectively the influencing factors of housing vacancy rate, At present, most of the analysis methods of these data are subjective methods such as investigation and research, the results often lack objectivity. This paper uses the grey correlation theory to analyze the relevant data of housing in a city from 2013 to 2020 characteristics of gray correlation are used to analyze the primary and secondary nature of factors that affect the housing vacancy rate, to achieve objective sort of various factors, so that main factors that affect the housing vacancy rate can be quickly identified. The policy provides an effective data basis. The effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by an example analysis of the factors affecting the vacancy of commercial housing in a certain city, the accuracy is higher than that of traditional methods.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of key characteristics of micro gas flow regulating valve
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Regarding the problems of micro gas flow regulating valve, including micron assembly, precise trim of the valve spool and dynamic sealing of the valve port, if we do not master its working principle and simulation method, it is challenging to optimize better products just using a large number of experiments. Herein, the flow regulating valve is modeled theoretically by using the circuit model, magnetic circuit model, dynamic model, and nozzle model with the help of MATLAB software. The simulation and analysis includes the study of the dynamic characteristics, voltage displacement characteristics, and voltage flow characteristics of the valve spool, along with the effect of preload height, air gap height, stiffness coefficient, and temperature on the key characteristic of the flow regulating valve. The experimental results are consistent with the simulations, indicating that the model developed in this paper is accurate and the simulation results are reliable. It can be used for the iterative design and optimization of flow regulating valves, as well as in the assembly of flow regulating valves and the fine-tuning of their characteristics in the manufacturing process.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of iPod Control Module in Car Audio System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of accurately controlling the external iPod in the car audio system so that the powerful iPod device can serve the whole car audio system, This paper proposes a direct connection to connect the iPod with the car audio system, and accurately control the iPod peripherals through the software structure of receiving trigger, internal processing and response. This method divides the iPod control module into the application layer and the driver layer. The application layer receives the external event triggers, calls the API interface of the driver layer, and completes the corresponding action. It is the only event entry of the iPod control module. The driver layer is mainly responsible for controlling the realization of the sound function. The process engine mechanism well solves the complex data and the corresponding state management problems in the design process. Experimental results show that this method enhances system reusability and portability, and is especially suitable for mass production development.

articleTitle: Extra-Trees for Human Activity Recognition Using Wearable Sensors
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Intelligent recognition is a hot keyword nowadays, meanwhile Human Activity Recognition (HAR) is one of the most popular research fields, and it also has a wide range of applications such as entertainment, health and safety. In recent years, machine learning methods have developed rapidly and have been applied to various scenarios. Therefore, we propose to apply the Extra-Trees algorithm to the HAR problem, and collect motion data through the wearable sensor device carried by the experimenter. In the test work on the public domain data set, the accuracy of the Extra-Trees algorithm reached 93.25%, while the accuracy of the KNN algorithm as a comparison was 90.77%, and the accuracy of the Decision Tree algorithm was only 87.75%.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Damage Effect of RC Slab under Air Explosion
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In this paper, the three-dimensional finite element model (FEM) of reinforced concrete slab was established by ANSYS/LS-DYNA software. The numerical simulations of the explosion responses of slab were carried out by LOAD_BLAST_ENHANCED (LBE) method. The dynamic responses and damage laws of slab under different conditions were analyzed, including different modeling method, charge, rebar diameter and constraint condition. Finally, the space-time conservation-element and solution-element (CESE) method was used to simulate the propagation processes of pressure and temperature of shock wave. The results show that the CESE method can be used to analyze the damage effect of target structure under complex explosion loads considering pressure shock and thermal shock.

articleTitle: Design of personalized tourism route recommendation system based on knowledge graph
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the development of tourism, the multiple values of recommendation system are reflected. When too many people are online, the system response time is long. To solve these problems, a personalized tourism route recommendation system based on knowledge graph is designed. Hardware part: through digital power supply to obtain analog power, ensure the full range of voltage consistent, connected to the relevant components; Software part: build user interest model, classify different neighbor node structure, use knowledge graph to optimize the scenic spot entity alignment process, obtain candidate site set, comprehensively calculate scenic spot recommendation score, design personalized tourism route recommendation system software storage function. Test results: The average response time of the personalized tourism route recommendation system in this paper and the other two systems were 11.260ms, 17.715ms and 18.129ms respectively. The results show that the application effect of personalized tourism route recommendation system is better after making full use of knowledge graph.

articleTitle: Calculation of shear capacity based on finite element
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to accurately calculate the shear capacity, a calculation method of shear capacity based on finite element is proposed in this paper. Based on the bending test of unreinforced ultra-high performance concrete rectangular beams with different steel fiber content, the ABAQUS finite element model of the test beam is established. The test results show that the finite element model is in good agreement with the load displacement curve of the test, and the calculation method of shear capacity based on finite element has better accuracy.

articleTitle: Motion Posture Recognition Method Based on RBF Neural Network Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the recognition rate of moving targets by radial basis function (RBF) neural network, a posture recognition algorithm based on optimized RBF is proposed. Firstly, the basic technology of human behavior recognition acquires in-depth analysis. Then, a dynamic adjustment of the important parameters of Levenberg-Marquardt with the number of iterative steps is put forward, to construct an adaptive RBF structure. Combined with the excellent global search ability of GA, it is also improved accordingly. Finally, the normalized motion history image (MHI) is used for image sequence representation for data processing. The simulation results show that our method reduces the over fitting degree of RBF, improves the generalization ability and calibration accuracy of LM-BP network, and can effectively recognize human posture categories.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Operation Safety Evaluation Method based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of large-scale distribution network operation data, such as different sampling scales, data errors and data dispersion, this paper proposes a distribution network operation safety evaluation method based on big data analysis. We make an in-depth analysis on the data sources and collection methods of distribution network, and focus on the filtering of bad data identification in multi-source data fusion. Then, association rules are established according to the operation state of intelligent distribution network to realize the division of extended clustering. Finally, combined with different data sources, the steps and framework of distribution network operation state evaluation are proposed, and the computing platform required for big data analysis is established. The test results show that the scheme effectively improves the ability of distribution network data analysis and mining, which can provide data support for distribution network planning and safe operation.

articleTitle: Analysis of Rural Tourism Characteristics Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the level of rural tourism, it is necessary to analyze the data characteristics of rural tourism.Through sorting out the relevant data of several online tourism platforms, the grey correlation theory is used to analyze these data.This article uses the grey correlation method to analyze the weight of factors affecting rural tourism hotspots, then to deduce main factors affecting rural tourism hotspots. From the results of the analysis, it can be concluded that the main factors affecting the number of rural tourist attractions are number of star-rated attractions (C4), highway mileage (C2) good air quality rate (C5) and number of star-rated hotels (C3).Finally,Empirical results show that the analysis of the influencing factors of rural tourism hotspots is consistent with the actual situation, which proves that this method is an effective method.

articleTitle: Research on Mining Methods of User Behavior Patterns in Smart Home
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To realize the user interaction of smart home, this paper focuses on the cluster analysis and association analysis technology, which is used to mine the control habits of smart home users, and proposes a mining and home appliance control strategy based on user behavior pattern. The algorithm mines frequent itemsets from user behavior data, evaluates it with association rules and obtains strong positive correlation association rules. Then it analyzes the association of user behavior in different time periods by using temporal association rule technology, uses hierarchical clustering method to analyze user behavior data, and obtains similar usage patterns between household appliances. Finally, according to the above-mentioned user behavior habits, the intelligent control design of household appliances is performed. The experimental results show that the association rule data mining method can predict the future behavior of users in smart home environment, and the Apriori algorithm based on hash technology can improve the efficiency of user behavior prediction in smart home.

articleTitle: Cable Vibration Mitigation with a Tuned Viscous Mass Damper
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Recent studies have demonstrated that the use of a tuned viscous mass damper (TVMD) is an effective approach for mitigating structural vibration. This paper investigates the performance of TVMD on cable vibration mitigation. Firstly, the dynamic formulation of the cable-TVMD system was established by the finite difference method. Based on the performance evaluation indexes of the modal damping ratio and the dynamic magnification factor, a cable attached with a TVMD was subsequently studied. Furthermore, based on the dynamic magnification factor at the cable midspan, a practical design methodology using contour plots was proposed for the cases where a viscous damper (VD), a viscous inertial mass damper (VMD), and a TVMD are attached to a cable. Finally, the effectiveness of the VD, the VMD, and the TVMD in mitigating cable vibrations was compared. It is shown that the TVMD has superior cable vibration mitigation performance to VD and VMD.

articleTitle: Power engineering cost prediction based on Fuzzy Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the prediction accuracy of power engineering cost, a fuzzy neural network algorithm based on artificial intelligence technology is proposed in this paper. Improve data accuracy. The algorithm combines the learning characteristics of neural network and the fault-tolerant advantages of fuzzy system. It uses k-mans algorithm to cluster the sample input space, generates membership matrix, and uses neural network algorithm to train the data, and finally completes the target output. Taking 200 historical data as an example, the fuzzy neural network algorithm is used to analyze it, and on this basis, the new power project cost is predicted. The analysis results can meet the existing engineering requirements.

articleTitle: An optimized Clustering Routing Algorithm Based on Entropy Empowerment and A* Search
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The life cycle of wireless sensor networks is directly related to the energy consumption of nodes. To balance the energy consumption of nodes, an optimized clustering routing algorithm based on entropy empowerment and A* search (ORAEA)is proposed. Through entropy weighting, the expected life of nodes, the density of neighbor nodes and the distance from the base station are objectively weighted, and high-quality cluster heads that adapt to the dynamic changes of the network are obtained, and the network is non-uniformly clustered; based on the energy consumption of the nodes and the distance from the base station The link transmission cost is calculated as the heuristic function of the A* search algorithm, and the multi-hop transmission route between cluster heads with the smallest transmission cost is obtained. Simulation experiments show that compared with LEACH, LEACH-C, and EEUC algorithms, the energy consumption of the cluster heads in this paper is more balanced, thus prolonging the network life cycle.

articleTitle: Summary of Research on Whispered Speech Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Speech recognition technology has been studied in normal speech and has achieved better recognition performance, but whispered speech recognition still needs a lot of research work. This article briefly introduces the development of whispered speech recognition technology in recent years, summarizes the application and improvement of traditional models in whispered speech recognition, and explains the main technologies, advantages and disadvantages of these methods. Due to the great contributions of deep learning and end-to-end to the field of whispered speech recognition, this article introduces their research results in the field of whispered speech recognition, and explains their main methods, advantages and disadvantages. On this basis, the whispered corpus and pseudo-whispered generation methods are summarized. Finally, the process of whispered speech research was discussed and analyzed objectively.

articleTitle: An Improved Bounding-box Adaptive Penalty Function Location Method Based on RSSI
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low convergence rate and poor positioning accuracy of the heuristic algorithm in RSSI positioning, an improved Bounding-box adaptive penalty function location method is proposed. In this method, the conventionally adopt quadrate communication area of anchor nodes is modified to circular in the Bounding-box algorithm, and their overlapping area is found. Then an adaptive penalty function is constructed to improve the efficiency of individual search in the early stage of optimization by the heuristic algorithm. The coordinates of the nodes can be obtained by minimizing the adaptive penalty function. The simulation results show that the positioning accuracy of the proposed positioning method is significantly improved compared with the traditional RSSI positioning algorithm and the positioning algorithm in literature [9].

articleTitle: Coordination and Optimization Strategy of Distribution Network Loss Based on Dynamic Load Variation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of distribution network line loss, a coordinated optimization method of distribution network line loss based on dynamic load change is proposed. UPFC is used to accurately control the power flow distribution and improve the power flow distribution of transmission lines. It effectively reduces the line loss caused by three-phase imbalance, improves the transmission capacity of the line and improves the reliability of the power grid. A new three-phase power compensation circuit is added to the UPFC device, which can automatically collect the voltage and current signals in the power grid circuit and calculate the collected voltage and current signals. The control circuit generates the calculated signal information to generate a driving signal, and sends the driving information to the main circuit. The main circuit compensates the grid current according to the driving signal, and the computer controls the operation process and displays the control results. Experiments show that the designed method significantly reduces the loss in the power grid circuit, improves the utilization of active power, and provides a good environment for the stable operation of the power grid circuit.

articleTitle: Coordinated Optimization Strategy of Composite Energy Storage in Distribution Network Based on Hierarchical Control
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to ensure the safe and stable operation of microgrid, an up-down inverter method is proposed according to the respective advantages of energy storage power supply. Hierarchical coordinated speed reduction control strategy, the upper vanadium redox flow battery energy storage adopts independent speed reduction control, and the super capacitor adopts speed reduction control strategy. The system is simulated by PSCAD professional software, and the simulation results verify the control strategy adopted in this paper. It can control the stable operation of microgrid and provide valuable reference and help for the configuration and design of high- capacity energy storage system in microgrid.

articleTitle: Closed loop Design of Urban Building Energy Conservation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the energy-saving effect of urban buildings, a basic closed-loop design concept is proposed in this paper. Based on the concept of closed-loop design, whole process of building construction is considered, such as architectural design, construction, materials, electrical, heating and ventilation, renovation. From the actual test of 500 sets of energy-saving buildings in a city, it can be concluded that Energy saving in the design stage reaches 2.3%; energy saving in the construction stage is 5.4%; energy saving in the HVAC stage is 4.8%; energy saving in the power supply and distribution stage is 2.2%;energy savingin lighting is 9.5%;energy savingin decoration is 1.1%;energy saving in external wall insulation is 1.3%. In total, 26.6% energy can be saved. From the empirical analysis, it can be concluded thatenergy saving of green buildings considering energy saving in all aspects can be concluded as follows. The effect of building energy conservation has been significantly improved, which can meet the comprehensive requirements of green building energy conservation in modern smart cities.

articleTitle: Visual Management System Design for Hybrid Vehicle Power Battery
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To realize the safety and visual management of hybrid vehicle power battery, a set of fully functional BMS is designed in this paper. The hardware core selects STM32f107vct6 as the processor, including basic management circuit, bus communication circuit and battery monitoring module, which constitutes a complete battery management hardware structure. The software system follows BMS design standard and compiles the program flow chart according to the module functions required by the main control board and data acquisition board. Then, based on Labview2020 graphical programming platform, the unified monitoring and management of the upper computer platform is completed. The system test results show that the system basically meets the actual demand for the estimation of battery state of charge, and the functions of residual power estimation and communication are correct and applicable.

articleTitle: An artifact removing method fusing FastICA and CNN for EEG signal
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Electroencephalogram (EEG) is susceptible to interference from various noises during the acquisition process. In order to remove artifacts and improve classification accuracy, an artifact removal algorithm that combines FastICA and convolutional neural networks is proposes. First, the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is used to detect artifacts by calculating the voltage amplitude of the EEG signal, and then the EEG signal containing artifacts is decomposed into independent components by the FastICA algorithm based on negative entropy; Then the threshold method is used to automatically identify the artifact components, and the identified artifact components are removed by FastICA; finally, a pure EEG signal is obtained through reconstruction. Experimental results prove that the fusion method can effectively remove artifacts while retaining useful EEG signals, and ultimately improve the classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Study on the handling and stability of the rhombic car based on two degree of freedom model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: According to the particularity of the rhombic car chassis layout, two degrees of freedom (2-DOF) handling model was established based on the front/rear wheel linkage steering. The stability factor was deduced based on the theory analysis, and the condition satisfied to under steering was determined. The handling and stability of the car was analyzed, mainly including the steady state and transient response based on the front wheel angle step input and the yaw-rate frequency response characteristics, and so on, and the effect to the handling and stability which was caused by the vibration of the car parameters was analyzed. The analysis results will be useful to select and adjust the car parameters of the rhombic car, and will have better reference significance to the engineering.

articleTitle: Network Public Opinion Analysis Based on LDA Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to effectively mine hidden research topics and potential evolution patterns from massive network public opinion data, this paper proposes a public opinion monitoring system based on LDA. The scheme mainly performs text crawling and topic extraction of network entities through self-programming by Python, and realizes fine-grained emotion analysis and topic mining combined with TF-IDF feature words and LDA model. Then, cluster analysis is made on the content and intensity of each stage of public opinion development, and the construction of topic model and topic confusion are extracted for further public opinion prediction. Finally, the LDA topic model is applied to the application of public opinion system, which realizes the intelligent monitoring, analysis and prediction function of public opinion, and it can quickly respond to the update and change of network public opinion.

articleTitle: Mobile Device Location Management Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To realize mobile device location and real-time monitoring, this paper proposes an effective scheme of mobile device positioning management by integrating Internet of things(IoT) and wireless LAN technology. Taking the LAN of a large medical unit as the deployment environment, we designed the overall structure of the IoT based on RFID according to the actual needs of equipment management. Then it provides the specific implementation process of the key technologies such as the hardware composition of the system, the deployment of network AP and the positioning and identification of RFID. Finally, by tracking the quality control and location dynamic information of medical equipment, the trajectory is sent to the server in real time, to realize accurate positioning of medical equipment. The system test results show that our method effectively combines the IoT with mobile collection, location management and other technologies, and solves the problems of hospital fixed assets account, material correspondence management and overall equipment supervision to the maximum extent.

articleTitle: Terminal Cluster Indoor Positioning Method Based on Time-Frequency Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The method of indoor positioning of terminal cluster based on time-frequency analysis is proposed, which uses time-frequency domain to characterize and analyze signals, and gets rid of the limitation of traditional single time-domain or frequency-domain description of signal characteristics. The time domain and frequency domain are combined to describe and observe the time-frequency characteristics of the signal, and how the spectrum content of the signal changes with time is analyzed through the time spectrum diagram. The hybrid precoding based on geometric mean decomposition is introduced to decompose the channel matrix into channels with the same diagonal element values. All diagonal element values are equal to the geometric mean of the eigenvalues of the channel matrix, so that the subchannel can obtain equal gain and avoid complex bit allocation. Finally, the weighted distance vector hop ranging method is adopted, and the signal intensity factor is introduced to weight the minimum hop number and average hop distance, so as to reduce the error caused by the minimum hop number and average hop distance in the conventional distance vector hop section.

articleTitle: Research on software fault mode time prediction method based on Matlab/Simulink virtual simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Reliability is a very important index of software, which needs strict testing, which is time-consuming and laborious. Traditional software reliability testing is carried out in the order of "constructing scenario profile, generating test cases and executing reliability testing". Only when the test samples are very rich, the test data generated by random sampling can accurately reflect the use distribution of the software. The increase of test data leads to the increase of profile, and the data collection is very difficult, so the existing test methods can not be widely tested. This paper analyzes the limitations of current software reliability testing, and puts forward a software failure mode time prediction method based on Matlab/Simulink virtual simulation, which can increase the description of software scene and monitor software reliability related data in real time. The test shows that the failure time can be obtained efficiently and quickly through the known failure mode, which can provide verification and data support for the research of software reliability.

articleTitle: Research on Personalized News Recommendation System Based on Collaborative Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The news that users are interested in changes over time. The current personalized news recommendation system does not consider the timeliness of news, which affects the recommendation effect. A personalized news recommendation system is designed based on collaborative filtering algorithm. In the hardware part, FPGA is used as the core logic control chip, the crystal oscillator output is directly connected to the global clock pin of FPGA, and the high and low level of output data is determined by the data byte control pin (LB, UB). In the software part, the overall architecture of the system software is designed based on the user log, and the personalized news recommendation model is established based on the collaborative filtering algorithm. The time decay function is introduced into the model to obtain the interest model belonging to each user, and find the news similar to the user’s preferences and push it to the user. The test results show that the recommendation effect of the system is the best when the number of users’ nearest neighbors is 30. The MAE of personalized news recommendation system based on collaborative filtering algorithm is 0.7488, which is 0.0648 and 0.0795 lower than that based on association rules and knowledge map. Therefore, the design system has better recommendation effect.

articleTitle: Study on generalized prediction model of investment capacity of complex power grid based on system dynamics theory
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: As the proportion of various distributed new energy sources in the power system continues to increase, the revenue of the regional power grids will be greatly affected, making the profit margin of power grid companies greatly reduced and investment capacity will be greatly restricted. This paper establishes a generalized forecasting model of power grid enterprise investment capacity under multi-objective constraints based on system dynamics, and conducts risk management and control research. Considering the three perspectives of net profit, financing and depreciation, considering the constraint conditions such as asset-liability ratio and capital guarantee ratio, combined with system dynamics theory, a system dynamics-based investment capability prediction model is constructed. By decomposing the investment capacity layer by layer, the generalized forecasting model formula is established, and the generalized forecasting curve reflecting the essential characteristics of power grid enterprises is obtained. providing an intuitive analysis and control curve for investment decisions.

articleTitle: Optimization design of integral steering Trapezoidal mechanism based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In this paper, a simplified plane mathematical model of integral steering trapezoidal mechanism is established and the functional relationship between the internal and external steering wheel angles under ideal and actual conditions is deduced. MATLAB software was used as the main optimization tool to establish the objective function and determine the constraints. Fmincon function in the MATLAB optimization toolbox was used to calculate the structural parameters of the steering trapezoidal mechanism most suitable for a certain type of ground support equipment, and then compared with the steering trapezoidal mechanism before optimization. It is confirmed that the method described in this paper can effectively optimize the integral steering trapezoidal mechanism.

articleTitle: Vehicle Load Model of Highway Bridge and Its Application in Earthquake Prevention and Disaster Reduction
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Vehicle load is the key live load for structural design and safety evaluation of highway bridges. Accurate and reliable vehicle load model is related to the safe operation of the bridge. According to the research results at home and abroad, the differences between the heavy vehicle load effect and the code load model effect under overload in various regions are analyzed. The results show that the load effect of heavy vehicles in some areas exceeds the effect of the standard model by about 20% ~ 50%, and the coverage capacity of the standard model is insufficient. The differences of vehicle load models in different regions are compared. The results show that the vehicle weight of the main vehicle model in most areas is about 250kN. The vehicle weight of the heavy vehicle model varies from region to region. It is about 770kN in most parts of China, which is larger than that in the United States and Europe. The application of vehicle load model in earthquake prevention and disaster reduction of highway bridges is further reviewed. Finally, the problems and challenges faced by highway bridge load model are discussed, and the future research hotspots are prospected.

articleTitle: 3D Key Frame Animation Generation Method Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the generation and recognition ability of 3D key frame animation, a 3D key frame animation generation method based on deep learning is proposed. Build the 3D key frame animation detection and frame stability control model, realize the dynamic parameter identification of 3D key frame animation through multi-dimensional space parameter detection technology, and establish the grey parameter analysis model of 3D key frame animation by using deep learning image stabilization control technology. According to the parameter detection results under deep learning control, combined with adaptive animation feature location and block detection technology, a 3D animation feature point fusion matching filter model is established, which can realize the detection and automatic reconstruction of 3D key frame animation. The test results show that this method has high accuracy and good block matching effect for the automatic reconstruction of 3D key frame animation, and improves the fidelity and fidelity of 3D key frame animation.

articleTitle: Torsional Behavior and Fatigue Assessment of H-shaped Arch Bridge Hanger by Wind-induced Vibration
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: H-shaped hanger in arch bridge due to its high slenderness ratio and low torsional stiffness is prone to wind-induced torsional motion under low wind speed, thus leading to the fatigue problem at the flange of hanger near the hanger-to-beam connection. The available data is relatively limited to evaluate the fatigue behavior under torsional response of the H-shaped hanger. To assess the impact of this behavior on the service life of the H-shaped arch bridge hanger, a finite element analysis and analytical investigation were undertaken based on the practical engineering of Dongping Bridge. The results obtained from the finite element analysis correlated well with analytical methods. The calculation showed that the fatigue life of the hanger was reduced with the increase of torsion angle. It was determined the angle range for the No.1 hanger of Dongping Bridge without fatigue failure. The torsion angle can be used as the design target of vibration control.

articleTitle: Design and Evaluation of A Multi-domain Software Defined Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Software defined network (SDN) uses the idea of hierarchical control plane and data plane to break the closure of traditional network equipment and increase scalability by programming. The data plane is only responsible for forwarding data according to the rules issued by the control plane. The function of the control plane mainly depends on the controller, while the traditional SDN is basically managed by a single controller. However, in practical application, with the gradual expansion of the network scale and the rapid growth of network information, the ability of the controller to process network information can no longer meet 3people's needs, and the SDN network ability of a single controller cannot keep up with the development, it is imperative to expand SDN into multi domain SDN with multi controller. In this paper, a multi domain SDN is designed and implemented. Under the assumption that a controller manages a domain, the multi domain SDN is divided into core domain and edge domain. The experimental environment is built with Mininet and Ryu to construct the network topology and realize the mutual Ping between hosts.

articleTitle: Intelligent Monitoring Approach in Distribution Network Automation System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To provide scientific research and judgment for the monitoring module and fault discovery in the distribution automation system, an intelligent fault research and judgment and disposal platform based on power grid monitoring data is developed in this paper. Based on the detailed analysis of the system requirements, we give the overall topology principle, hardware and software architecture of the system. Apriorimining is mainly used to realize that there are different logical trigger conditions for different types of data, so as to accurately judge the fault location and type. The platform visualization module is integrated with GIS to realize real-time data sharing and whole process positioning. System operation and case analysis show that the equipment management and fault location strategy designed in this paper is relatively accurate and complete, which can quickly isolate faults, better serve the operation management of distribution network and ensure the safe and stable operation of automation system.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Diagnosis Model Based on the Medical Knowledeg Graph of Multi-source Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of the shortage of online medical resources caused by the surge in the amount of online medical consultation and the ineffective use of a large amount of medical data, this paper proposes a comprehensive online intelligent consultation program. First, obtain heterogeneous data sources through multiple channels, use deep learning technology to build a medical knowledge graph, and store it as a knowledge repository then build an intelligent automatic consultation model and medical knowledge retrieval query model, use natural language processing technology to parse semantics for the question of users, and the answer is retrieved in the medical knowledge repository through the semantic query logic conversion, and finally an intelligent questioning model based on the medical knowledge graph covering the whole disease is implemented. This solution can not only meet the needs of patients for online consultation, reduce the workload of medical staff, but also provide clinical decision support services, improve the accuracy of intelligent diagnosis, and reduce the inaccuracy rate of expert decision-making and the cost of consultation.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Car-Following Modal Based on LSTM Deep Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In this paper, a data-driven car-following model based on the long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network in deep learning is proposed. Different from the traditional theoretical model, it can portray the complex decision-making and execution behaviors of drivers more accurately. The speed difference and the spacing between the leading vehicle and the following vehicle are set as the model input while the speed of the follower is set as the output. We determine the optimal values of parameters such as training times and the proportion of data used for testing and training and complete the modeling, testing, and optimization. Compared with other models, this model has two distinctive properties: First, it takes time-series data into consideration, which means the micro-behaviors of drivers such as the predictive ability and memory effects are integrated with the macroscopic traffic flow model. Second, we compared this model with models based on other neural networks such as SVR, FNN, and RNN. Respectively, the error value of this model is 83.8%, 69.5%, and 44.2% lower than those of the other three, which indicates that the car-following model based on LSTM has higher simulation accuracy than other kinds of the car following models.

articleTitle: Modeling of risk assessment for stay cable based on improved ALARP
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The establishment of an accurate model for the risk assessment of stay cables can effectively avoid accidents and prolong the service life of stay cables. This paper proposes an improved risk assessment method based on ALARP criterion and cloud model theory. Firstly, the risk matrix is formed by using risk probability and risk loss. The inherent uncertainty is considered through the evaluation process, and the risk level is described by cloud model. Then, the cloud samples of evaluation indicators are generated according to the ranking of experts, and further transmitted to the forward cloud generator to obtain the certainty level. Finally, the effectiveness and rationality of the improved ALARP method are compared with the traditional method. The results show that the maximum error can be reduced by 54.18%. The improved ALARP principle proposed in this paper can be used as an effective basis for the management and maintenance of stay cables.

articleTitle: Dynamic Response of Continuous Rigid Frame bridge with Single Thin-Wall Piers under Vehicle Impact Load
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In this paper, MSC. Marc software was applied to establish fine finite element models of vehicle and bridge considering material nonlinearity, geometric nonlinearity, contact nonlinearity and material rate effect. Numerical simulation of the collision process between vehicle and bridge was conducted based on the FE model. The dynamic response of the bridge in the process of vehicle impact was obtained by dynamic time history analysis, and the damage state of the pier was determined by the distribution of stress and strain of the pier. The results show that although the equivalent impact force exceeds the value specified in the Chinese code, the service performance is rarely affected when 49t six-axis vehicle hitting against the pier at 60km/h. The influence of impact parameters, i.e., vehicle weight, impact speed and impact angle and other parameters on impact force was analyzed, and the collision forces in parameter analysis cases were compared with domestic and international standards. The results show that: both peak impact force and equivalent impact force approximately linearly increase with the increase of impact velocity; both peak impact force and equivalent impact force increase with the increase of impact mass; the peak impact force and the equivalent impact force calculated at 10° and 20° are similar, while the calculated results at 30° are significantly less than aforementioned conditions.

Author Keywords: Single Thin-Wall Continuous Rigid Frame Bridge

articleTitle: Applicability Analysis of New Pile-slab Road Corbel Based on ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to observe and optimize the applicability analysis of the new pile-slab subgrade, this study used the general finite element analysis software ANSYS to establish a refined finite element model of the corbel expansion joint structure, and carried out loading analysis on the finite element model, and passed The finite element analysis data was compared and verified under different working conditions, and the refined finite element model was modified to make it more in line with the actual situation, so that the study can truly reflect the actual use performance and bearing performance of the pile-slab subgrade. . By analyzing the force performance of the weak section of the corbel, the overall force performance of the joint connection structure and the force performance of the key components of the new expansion joint, the force performance and force characteristics of the structure are obtained.

articleTitle: Bridge Safety Monitoring Method Based on GA Optimized Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To scientifically perform health monitoring and safety evaluation of bridges, a new bridge safety evaluation method is proposed based on genetic algorithm and BP neural network. We analyze the implementation principle of neural network technology in engineering structure damage detection, and focus on the functional characteristics and sample set composition of neural network suitable for bridge damage identification. Then, GA is used to optimize the weight and threshold of BP neural network, and the specific implementation process is provided. Finally, referring to the actual highway bridge data, the large-scale complex finite element model is established by using numerical simulation object, and the scheme is simulated and tested in MATLAB. The case analysis results also show that the algorithm has fast convergence speed and high prediction accuracy, which provides a new idea for bridge safety monitoring.

articleTitle: Bayesian classification based pose contour extraction method for moving images
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of large error and long time-consuming in the traditional motion image attitude contour extraction results, a motion image attitude contour extraction method based on Bayesian classification is proposed. MEMS sensor is used to calibrate the real-time posture of human motion process, determine the posture of moving image, and Bayesian model is used for classification. The log operator is introduced to determine the edge indication function under the adaptive surface evolution extreme value, and combined with the reverse CRF transform to extract the pose contour of the moving image. The experimental results show that the iteration times and time-consuming, signal-to-noise ratio and SSE value of this method are better than those of the traditional method.

articleTitle: A Mathematical Model of Traffic Guidance Information for Transportation Hub
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To study the effect of traffic guidance information for transportation hub, this model digitizing the degree of information transparency (DIT), and it divides the traffic sign system into nodes and paths. Corresponding to the system function, The node part mainly analyzes the diversion effect, and the path part mainly analyzes the guidance effect. Discussing the influence of DIT on passenger branch decision in Multinomial Logit (MNL). Moreover, on the basis of practical experience, three properties of pathDIT that can make the model more closer to reality are specified: error correction, transitivity, and decay ability. Finally, the model is used in the simulation experiment in MATLAB. In conclusion, a DIT model based on MNL and actual data is established, which is a mathematical model of digitized guidance information that can be used for simulation in transportation hub, and the model can provide data support for traffic flow distribution and utility theory.

articleTitle: Design of Integrated Medical Equipment Management System Based on IoTs
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the comprehensive informatization level of large hospitals, this paper establishes a management system to monitor the use of hospital medical equipment through IoTs(IoTs) technology. We propose a hierarchical structure of equipment management system based on IoTs, and complete the design of data logic, data structure and data flow of the system. The sensing network composed of RFID tag and reader is constructed, and the specific data transmission scheme is also provided. Then, combined with the specific requirements, the implementation scheme and implementation method of hardware and software are put forwarded. Finally, through the running test of the system, it is verified that the system can correctly handle the user's business logic. Our scheme makes the management of high-value equipment transparent, more dynamic tracking of equipment, and enhances the visibility and controllability of equipment management.

articleTitle: Prediction of traffic mode selection based on MNL model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The analysis of travel mode choice is important in transportation planning and policy-making in order to understand and forecast travel demands. The Multinomial Logit (MNL) Model is a powerful method for constructing an ensemble of random decision trees. It de-correlates the decision trees in the ensemble via utility random term that leads to an improvement of forecasting and reduces the variance when averaged over the trees. This paper proposes a nonrandom subset Multinomial Logit method to analyze travel mode choices for examining the prediction capability and model interpretability. Using SP survey data of Swiss metro system in 2017, the influence of model parameters on prediction performance is studied. The results show that MNL method has a high prediction accuracy (82.18%) and a low computational amount, and has a good effect in the prediction of travel mode selection. The prediction effect of subway is 83.96%, so the construction of subway should be preferred in urban transportation planning.

articleTitle: Damage Identification of Bridge Based on Kalman Filter by Using Partial Structural Measurements
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The damage identification of bridge structures is still a challenging task. The identification accuracy of most current methods relies on the location and number of sensors adopted. In this paper, based on the Kalman filter algorithm, a novel method is proposed to identify the damage of bridge structure by using only partially measured structural responses. The damage occurred is regarded as the sudden degradation of the stiffness parameter. Thus, the abruptly changing stiffness parameter can be represented by three coefficients, that is, the undamaged stiffness value, the damage instant, and the damaged stiffness value. In this way, the identification of each stiffness parameter is transformed into the identification of three coefficients instead. Then, the Kalman filter algorithm is used for the identification of structural state using partially measured structural responses. Finally, three defined coefficients are estimated by the nonlinear least-squares optimization, and the original abruptly changing stiffness parameters can be reconstructed. Numerical simulation is conducted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method. It is demonstrated that only a few accelerometers are required in the proposed method, and the identification accuracy is not depend on the position of sensors. In addition, the proposed method is capable to identify the damages quantitatively and directly with no need to locate damages in advance.

articleTitle: Human motion abnormal posture monitoring method based on Intelligent Bracelet
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problem of low classification accuracy and monitoring accuracy of sample data in traditional abnormal posture monitoring methods, a new human motion abnormal posture monitoring method based on Intelligent bracelet is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the structure of smart Bracelet sensor is analyzed, and Gabor transform method is used to collect human motion data. Secondly, based on the data acquisition results, the appearance model of abnormal posture monitoring of human motion is constructed, and the output result of the model is the abnormal posture monitoring result of human motion. Finally, a comparative verification experiment is carried out. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional monitoring methods, the sample data classification accuracy of this method is higher, and it can accurately monitor the abnormal posture of human movement.

articleTitle: Urban traffic signal control based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Urban traffic signal control only controls individual intersections with high traffic flow, ignoring the correlation of traffic in the area, which leads to poor delay time and capacity of intersections. To optimize the above problems, urban traffic signal control based on genetic algorithm is studied. The migration learning principle combined with fuzzy rules is used to detect the passage status of the intersection. The delay time and capacity of the intersection are targeted, and an urban traffic signal control model is developed. After improving the crossover variation of the genetic algorithm, the control model is solved and the traffic signal control scheme is obtained. The experimental results on the urban road network show that the total delay time in the urban area is optimized by at least 7.5% after applying the genetic algorithm, and the communication capacity is significantly improved, which enhances the traffic efficiency of the urban road network.

articleTitle: Smart Contract-based Crowdsensing Framework for Internet of Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Crowdsensing of Internet of Vehicles (IoV) can make full of use of the mobility of vehicles to provide data collection services to individuals in deed. In this paper, we elaborate on the framework, operation procedures of both centralized and distributed crowdsensing frameworks in IoV, and analyze the system complexity, secure communication, data storage and other problems facing the current architecture. In order to solve these problems, this paper proposed a crowdsensing framework of IoV based on blockchain and smart contract on the basis of introducing vehicular edge computing; Secondly, a multi-level smart contracts interaction system were built which designed a detailed multi-module smart contract; Finally, a specific scheme for performing sensing tasks is presented on this framework, showing the communication between different entities. The simulation test and performance evaluation certify the availability, security and convenience of the framework.

articleTitle: Classification of Lung CXR Images Using a Lightweight Network MobilenetV3
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The COVID-19 has become a huge factor affecting human health and has caused huge losses to the world. How to accurately and effectively distinguish the infected has become an important measure to prevent the spread of the epidemic. However, the currently commonly used detection technology is Polymerase chain reaction (PCR), which is very labor-intensive, dangerous and inaccurate by manual detection and differentiation by humans. Therefore, this paper uses the MobilenetV3 network model to conduct a large number of experiments in 8282 lung X-ray images, and finally achieves fast and accurate classification of four types of lung X-ray images, and the classification accuracy rate reaches 97.2%. The COVID classification precision, recall and specificity reached 100%, 98.5% and 100%, respectively.

articleTitle: Moving Image Feature Extraction Method Based on Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The accuracy of traditional image feature extraction algorithm for accurate recognition of moving images is not high. To solve such problem, a target recognition algorithm based on edge contour feature segmentation using wavelet transform technology is proposed in this paper. Firstly, through multi-scale moving target edge detection, the process of moving target image acquisition and preprocessing is standardized. Then, using the information redundancy of stationary wavelet transform to remove noise, an image denoising method based on adaptive soft threshold is put forward. Finally, the improved method is tested in the simulation environment. The results show that the root mean square error of pixel feature matching is low, the corner extracted under different thresholds is reliable, and the motion estimation accuracy is better than that of similar algorithms.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Geometry Parameters in Vehicle-Pier Collision based on Dynamic Response Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The influences of three geometrical parameters, which are longitudinal slope along the bridge, horizontal impact angle and horizontal eccentricity, on the peak impact force in the vehicle-pier collision are analyzed. Using ANSYS and LS-DYNA finite element software, a vehicle-pier collision model dynamic finite element model is established. Taking a square bridge pier as an example, the effects of the above three parameters on the impact force under different vehicle speed conditions are analyzed. The results show that at the speeds of 40km/h, 60km/h and 80km/h, the peak impact force value increases with the increase of speed. At the same speed, as the slope increases, the relationship curve between the slope and the impact force along bridge shows a decreasing trend; As the horizontal impact angle increases, the relationship curve between the horizontal impact angle and the impact force along bridge shows a decreasing trend; With the threshold value of 0.8m for horizontal eccentricity, as the eccentricity increases, the peak collision force first increases and then decreases. The research points out the trend of the relationship between the collision geometry parameters and the peak value of impact force , which can provide a theoretical basis for bridge collision prevention decision and design.

articleTitle: Project Cost Risk Assessment of Distributed Generation Distribution Network Based on Statistical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to accurately evaluate the cost risk of distributed generation distribution network and ensure the safe operation of distributed generation distribution network. In risk assessment, it is necessary to calculate the maximum investment income of power grid cost, obtain the risk factors of distributed generation distribution network project cost, and improve the project cost risk assessment method of distributed generation distribution network based on engineering quantity mode. This paper constructs the profit optimization model of unbalanced bidding of engineering projects, calculates the optimal cost information of bidding enterprises, and obtains the project cost risk factors of distributed generation distribution network. The value at risk (VaR) and Monte Carlo method are used to evaluate the risk of distributed generation distribution network project cost. The simulation results show that the improved method can accurately evaluate the power grid cost risk.

articleTitle: Design of Electromagnetic Smart Car Based on MC9S12XS128
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to design an electromagnetic intelligent vehicle that can meet the requirements, the electromagnetic intelligent vehicle designed in this paper adopts c9sl2xsl28 single chip microcomputer as the main control chip. The road signal used for road tracking is the voltage signal value induced in the magnetic field by the inductor and the collected value of the electromagnetic sensor after amplification and rectification. The PWM pulse input with different duty cycle is controlled through the MCU port, It is used to control the steering angle and motor speed of the steering gear. In the test road environment with 20kHz and 100mA square wave signal, the intelligent vehicle is allowed to follow the predetermined track on the road including road elements such as cross turn and right angle turn, which has a good effect in the actual test.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Traffic Control System Based on Multi-Agent
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Since 2010, the level of urbanization in China has gradually improved, the urban population has increased rapidly, vehicles, especially private cars, have also increased rapidly, roads have become more and more dense, and road congestion has brought tremendous pressure to urban traffic.The multi-agent intelligent traffic control system is composed of a plurality of autonomous agents, and the agents communicate, cooperate and cooperate with each other, so that various problems caused by the change of the traffic flow to the control strategy of a intersection can be well solved, the traffic rate of the intersection can be improved to a certain extent, and the utilization rate of traffic road resources is improved. It reduces road traffic congestion, reduces energy consumption and exhaust pollution caused by road congestion, and shortens people's travel time.

articleTitle: Construction and Intelligent Application of Map Projection Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The Map Projection module is indispensable in the research process of Intelligent Transportation and Smart City related projects. Aiming at the problems of inconvenient query of Map Projection knowledge, poor intelligent selection effect and less research results of Map Projection knowledge map at present, a method for constructing a Map Projection Knowledge Graph based on domain ontology for multi-source data is proposed. This article has defined the concept of Map Projection Knowledge Graph, explained the basic process and key technologies of this method in detail, and verified the feasibility of this method in practice through experiments. This method has been proved that it is more intuitive and clear than traditional methods in visualization, and as a new method in Knowledge Query and Map Projection Intelligent Selection for this area at the same time by experiment in this article.

articleTitle: A complex network modeling for job-shop manufacturing system
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Job-shop manufacturing systems are typically systems handling productions in which machines are aggregated in shops by the nature of technological processes involved. The complex network modeling can provide sound solutions for the analysis on large-scale and complex Job-shop manufacturing systems. In this paper, a complex network based method to model the job-shop manufacturing system is introduced.
