With this method, the equipments in the job-shop manufacturing system are regarded as nodes while the workflow relations between them are represented as edges. The complex network model of the job-shop manufacturing system is established with the expression as N = {V, E, W, w}. Two topological metrics, namely the degree of the node and its betweenness centrality, are introduced to make a full analysis on the characteristics of the system. Then a HP-24 semiconductor production line is provided as a case study. The case study reveals that PHBI has more loads than other device, while TU11, TU72 and PLMSO appear more inclined to be a bottleneck as a matter of cause. The work of the paper can provide an effective approach to model the make characteristics analysis of Job-shop manufacturing systems and methods involved can provide an overall indication of the job-shop manufacturing system, and thus facilitate characteristics analysis of the system.

articleTitle: Vehicle group path planning algorithm considering equilibrium
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The congestion problem of a large number of vehicles traveling during morning and evening rush hours is an urgent problem to be solved. Vehicle routing is a way to solve the traffic congestion problem. In order to solve this problem, based on the analysis of the characteristics of vehicle travel in the morning and evening peak hours, the path planning strategy for a group of vehicles is studied. This paper establishes a balanced use model for road networks, and the overall income and arrival time are used as the constraint condition. Based on the model, the ant colony algorithm is used to plan the group vehicle path, and the group path planning optimizes the road utilization. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can reasonably use the road network resources, and the time for all vehicles to arrive at the destination is less than that of the shortest path algorithm.

articleTitle: Traffic Flow Prediction Method Based on Big Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To predict the state of urban short-term traffic flow in real time and accurately, this paper puts forward a feasible scheme to realize traffic flow prediction by big data mining technology. Combined with the characteristics of urban traffic flow, we process and extract the collected data based on wavelet. Then, the relevant knowledge in the field of data mining is used to find the hypothesis rules most similar to current traffic flow characteristics. We also discuss the feasibility of machine learning to mine data with similar change trend from massive data for short-term traffic prediction, and provide the specific solution process. Finally, a more optimized frequent set computing method and implementation scheme are proposed through MapReduce on the cloud computing platform. The test results of the prediction model show that the excavated congestion conduction rules can accurately analyze the traffic congestion and it can be used to provide guidance paths for vehicles in real time within a local range.

articleTitle: Research on a Wargaming System for Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The automatic decision-making confrontation for wargames is faced with the related difficulties of large amount of information, incomplete information and high decision-making complexity. To overcome these problems, this paper sorts out the basic concepts and process framework of combat mission planning in wargames, and analyzes the application method of deep reinforcement learning in the intelligent game process based on wargaming system, and proposes the optimization scheme of deep reinforcement learning in wargaming system, which provides a new research idea for the intelligent development of wargaming. Experiments show that the intelligent wargaming system based on deep reinforcement learning has significant advantages over the traditional wargaming system in data processing, decision-making speed and strategies.

articleTitle: Face Feature Extraction Algorithm Based on Wavelet Transform and CNN
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To improve the accuracy and efficiency of face recognition algorithm, a convolution neural network(CNN) face feature recognition scheme based on wavelet transform is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the face image is decomposed into four regions with different frequencies and scales by wavelet transform. Then, the compressed image is transformed by discrete cosine transform, and the weighted distance is used for classification and recognition. The improved lightweight CNN is adopted in face recognition algorithm to effectively eliminate the noise. Based on MATLAB platform, the feasibility of such method is tested in the collected face image database. The simulation results show it has higher recognition rate and robustness, and better comprehensive performance compared with the traditional algorithm.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction and Classification of EEG Signal Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to remove the noises mixed in EEG signals and improve the classification accuracy of motor imagery EEG signals, an EEG processing method based on EMD+ICA+ deep learning is proposed in this paper. First, both independent component analysis (ICA) and empirical mode decomposition (EMD) are used to remove noise interferences such as electrooculogram (EOG) and electrocardiogram (ECG) mixed in EEG signals. This method can retain useful EEG information while denoising. It can provide good conditions for further feature extraction and pattern recognition. The second step is to use the time-frequency analysis method to combine the time, frequency and position information extracted from the EEG signals to extract the time-frequency diagram of the EEG signal. The time-frequency diagram is used to characterize the complex information of the EEG signals. The third step is to take time-frequency graph as the input of a 2-layer convolutional neural network (CNN) with a two-dimensional convolution and maximum pooling layer. In the neural network, the generalization of the model is improved by introducing batch normalization (BN), and the rectified unit (ReLU) is used in the convolutional layer to accelerate the training. The feature extraction and classification steps are combined into one process for feature extraction and classification. Finally, the classification accuracy are used in the experiment to evaluate the performance of the method. The experimental results show that the neural network classification method proposed in this paper has high accuracy and reliability.

articleTitle: Color enhancement of brand trademark image based on smooth filtering algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Current color enhancement methods will excessively eliminate noise in image processing, resulting in the loss of color information and details in the image, affecting the effect of color enhancement. In order to improve the defects of the above color enhancement methods, a brand image color enhancement method based on smooth filtering algorithm is studied. After the histogram is used to equalize the image, the color of the image is segmented to obtain the color information. Based on Gaussian filter, a joint bilateral filter is designed to smooth the image. Deep learning convolutional network is constructed to realize image color enhancement by encoding and decoding. The simulation results show that the CNI value of the enhanced image is closer to 1, the color quality of the image is better, and the color enhancement effect of the method is better.

articleTitle: Intelligent prediction method of construction cost based on GA-BP algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low prediction accuracy of traditional construction cost prediction methods, a new intelligent prediction method of construction cost based on GA-BP algorithm is proposed in this paper. First of all, make clear the composition and main content of construction cost. Secondly, the main structure of basic BP neural network is analyzed, and the BP neural network is optimized by genetic algorithm. The main process of optimization is to optimize the weight and threshold of BP neural network through crossover and mutation in genetic algorithm, so as to improve the calculation performance of BP neural network. Finally, based on the optimized BP neural network, the construction cost prediction model of construction engineering is constructed, and the model is solved to complete the intelligent prediction of construction cost of construction engineering. The experimental results show that under the set parameters, when the number of iterations reaches 108, the mean square difference does not change, and the mean square difference is 3.5924×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup>. Moreover, the proposed prediction method has high cost prediction accuracy, and the prediction accuracy of the proposed method is always 96%.

articleTitle: Artificial Ground Motions using Hibert-Huang Transform and Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In this paper, an artificial ground motions generation method is proposed based on the radial basis function neural network (RBFNN). The inputs of the RBFNN are the pseudospectral velocities (PSVs) of the ground motions and the outputs are the frequency information and amplitude information obtained using the Hibert-Huang transform (HHT). Because the frequency and amplitude are predicted independently, the prediction is more accurate and efficient. In order to evaluate the accuracy and efficiency of these artificial ground motions, a five-storey steel frame is modeled and the seismic responses of the structure are obtained. The results show that the artificial ground motions predict the same seismic responses as the original ones..

articleTitle: Garage Door Monitoring and Control System for Fully Automatic Operation (FAO) Line
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The electric garage door of the traditional metro depot does not have remote control functions, and generally requires manual operation at the local location. There are problems such as low safety and complicated operation, which can’t meet the needs of FAO line. Aiming at this problem, a garage door monitoring and control system for FAO line is designed. Its control system has three-level control mode, which can realize automatic control mode under signal interlocking, remote manual control mode under Integrated Backup Panel (IBP), and local control mode. Its priority can be switched by hardware, and each door has necessary safety protection functions. The monitoring system is a master-slave structure connected by CAN bus. The monitoring host can summarize, store and display the operation status and fault information of each garage door, so as to realize the real-time monitoring. The garage door system applied to the FAO line, can improve the level of automation and the operation efficiency, ensure the safe entry and exit of the train.

articleTitle: 3D Modeling Reconstruction of Bridges Based on 2D Digital Images
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Traditional bridge modeling methods often use 2D drawings for modeling, which is difficult to show the authenticity of the model. With the development of computer technology and the proposal of the concept of digital twin, the visual model is required to be closer to the entity. In this paper, an image 3D reconstruction method is proposed to establish the 3D model of the real bridge. Firstly, the image is collected around the target bridge, then the sparse point cloud model of the bridge is reconstructed by SFM(Structure From Motion) algorithm, the point cloud is densified by MVS(Multi-View Stereo) algorithm, and the model surface is constructed by Poisson Surface Reconstruction algorithm. Finally, the color and texture of the model are given by Texture Mapping algorithm to complete the reconstruction of the 3D model. The test shows that the maximum error of bridge reconstruction is only 3.3%, which can meet the needs of bridge integrity research.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Manufacturing Workshop Management System Based on BOM
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to quickly and effectively improve the management efficiency of intelligent manufacturing workshop, this paper puts forward a design scheme of management system based on BOM. Firstly, through the implementation of enterprise PLM life cycle management system, the main framework of MES based on BOM is created. Then it analyzes the integration of workshop production BOM management system and other subsystems of workshop production management, formally describes the workshop scheduling and quality tracking model, and provides the specific optimization strategy. By combining with web service and database technology, it also provides visual online management function. The system test results show that the system solves the current situation of too scattered and disordered data in the manufacturing workshop, and improves the quality control ability of intelligent manufacturing products.

articleTitle: Structural design and performance test of venturi steam trap with flow rate adaptive adjustment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of existing venturi steam traps in practical application, a new type of venturi steam trap with self-adaptive flow rate was proposed. The structure of the venturi steam trap has the characteristics of automatic drainage and good drainage effect, small size, low failure rate and long service life. Of venturi steam hydrophobic internal parts structure design theory, the new type of venturi tube throat diameter was determined and the expansion period of Angle and length, using FLUENT software to the new designed venturi steam trap are simulated, and compared with the original venturi steam drain structure carries out a comparative analysis on the simulation results, the simulation results show that: The effect of hydrophobicity is more obvious when the venturi tube is extended. The new venturi steam trap was cast and tested on the spot. The test results showed that the experimental results were highly consistent with the theoretical results, and the new Venturi steam trap could meet the technological requirements.

articleTitle: Optimal Control Method of Building Construction Cost Based on Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In the construction of prefabricated buildings, the traditional cost control method cannot control the cost scientifically, and there are phenomena such as material waste. In order to reduce the cost of prefabricated construction, based on the concept of data fusion, a construction cost control method for the whole process is studied. Using the cost control method of building prefabricated structure, on the basis of the cost comparison between prefabrication and cast-in-place, combined with value engineering theory, quota design, 4D and diagrams, the influencing factors of the cost of each construction stage are analyzed. Virtual construction technology progress management method, component production process analysis and construction simulation, integration of project cost and graphical processing of big data, and establishment of a large-scale project cost database. Combined with big data technology, use logic sequence and other information to carry out data fusion analysis to realize project cost control. The simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively control the construction cost, accurately generate progress statistics, and realize the dynamic management of project resources.

articleTitle: Improved Zero-forcing and Minimum Mean Square Error Detection Algorithms for Space - time Encoder
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The application of Massive MIMO technology in 5G mobile communication system helps to improve coverage, increase channel capacity and reduce interference. The performance and complexity of receiver detection algorithm in MIMO system directly affect the performance and implementation of the system. In order to make a reasonable choice between the performance and complexity of the detection algorithm, an improved detection algorithm for the vertical Bell Laboratory layered space-time (V-BLAST) receiver is proposed based on the zero-forced (ZF) criterion and the minimum mean square error (MMSE) criterion. Comprehensive experimental and simulation results show that: The improved algorithm can analyze the performance index of each layer in ideal and non-ideal interference elimination. The performance of MMSE criterion detection algorithm is better than that of ZF criterion detection algorithm.

articleTitle: Vibration Reduction Analysis of Hybrid Control of Stay Cable using EMID and TMD
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to effectively reduce the cable amplitude, both EMID and TMD are used to reduce the vibration of the stay cable. In this study, the complex eigenvalue method is used to simulate and analyze the responses of the stay cable coupled with an electromagnetic inertial damper and a tuned mass damper. To maximize the modal damping ratio of the coupled system, the optimized parameters of the tuned mass damper and the electromagnetic inertial damper under different mass ratios and inertial mass ratios are obtained, respectively. Compared with the optimized parameters of a single tuned mass damper, the results show that the electromagnetic inertial damper and the tuned mass damper coupled system can provide more additional modal damping ratios for hybrid control of stay cables.

articleTitle: Surgical Navigation System Design for Surgery Aided Diagnosis Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: A conceptual medical robotic system applicable for the process of surgery aided diagnosis platform (SADP) is proposed in this paper. According to the requirement of SADP, the surgical navigation system is established. The navigation system proposed a set of image intensification algorithm, which can enhance the images visual effect and surgery precision. At last, the experimental results made for the prototype illustrate the system well. This research will lay a good foundation for the development of a medical robot to assist in SADP.

articleTitle: Analysis of Dispersion Characteristics of Typical Tower Grounding Device under Continuous Lightning Impact
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: As lightning strikes usually include multiple return strikes, the effect of multiple currents on grounding devices needs further research. In this paper, the dispersion characteristics of tower grounding devices with different materials based on the continuous impact test platform is analyzed. The results show that the impact grounding resistance of the grounding device is related to the time interval between impact pulses. When the time interval is small, the impact grounding resistance is less than the single impact grounding resistance. With the increase of time interval, the impact grounding resistance is restored to the primary impact grounding resistance. However, within a certain time interval, the grounding resistance of a grounding device in moist soil under a double pulse is greater than that of a single pulse.

articleTitle: Parametric Modeling for Bridge structures Based on Dynamo
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In Revit software, the bridge model is not accurate enough due to the need to manually pick the location of the bridge ’’double slope" components. In order to improve the accuracy of the bridge model, taking Huzhou inner ring Fenghe bridge as an example, the three-dimensional model of the bridge is accurately established by using the open source tool dynamo. In the process of building the model, the data transmission of Excel, Revit and dynamo is completed by calling and combining dynamo nodes. This updated "Data-Driven" method can quickly and accurately locate these components of the bridge, and effectively improve the quality of the bridge model.

articleTitle: Optimization on Design Parameters of Concrete-filled Steel Tubes Arch Bridge Based on Stability
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: A Nelson system tied arch bridge was used as an example on Zheng-Wan Railway to establish a finite element model to study the influence of hanger arrangement, arch rib inclination and transverse bracing stiffness on the stability of concrete-filled steel tube tied arch bridges. The structural optimization parameters were optimized by response surface analysis. An optimization design method for Nielsen system steel tube arch bridge was built. The method was verified by numerical simulation. The results show that a reasonable hanger arrangement angle can make full use of the stability advantages of the inclined hanger, the arch rib inclination parameter has a significant influence on the stability of the arch bridge, and the first-order stability of the arch bridge structure and the transverse brace stiffness show an approximately linear positive correlation.

Author Keywords: Concrete filled steel tubes tied arch bridge

articleTitle: Design of Robot Positioning System Based on the Integration of Slam System and Inertial System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Slam robot positioning system based on vision has good universality, but the depth information of the environment is lost due to low bandwidth, uncertainty of visual image change and poor real-time performance of motion mutation. In order to solve the above problems, a robot positioning system based on the integration of slam system and the inertial system is proposed. The hardware part designs inertial sensor modules such as accelerometer, odometer and gyroscope, and integrates the inertial sensor module with slam system. The IMU motion model is used to predict the attitude of the camera in the current frame and match the feature points of the current frame. The state of the robot is estimated by using the inertial sensor data of binocular vision, and the position and attitude of the robot are determined by slam according to the estimated value. The system test results show that the maximum positioning error rate of the system is only 1.8%, the positioning time is short and the performance is good.

articleTitle: Safety Early Warning of Live Operation of Distribution network Based on State Identification
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the identification performance of distribution network operation state and weak link identification, through the in-depth analysis of distribution network operation state data with weak link positioning ability, this paper obtains the data model required for the research, and constructs different analysis templates to check the weak link factors under normal production and operation state. The experimental results show that under the same operating conditions, the positioning error studied by this method is 0.2 lower than that in the literature. When the identification time is 5 days, the positioning error studied by this method is 0.2 lower than that in the literature, and the method is close to zero.

articleTitle: An Evaluating Method of QoS for Composite Services Based on Interval Muti-attribute Decision Making
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Composite Web services needs to meet the global Quality of Service (QoS) requirements of Customers. The evaluation of the services QoS is a important standard to make decision from numerous candidate composite services. However, due to the difficulty on the exact measurement of services QoS and exact expression of customers’ QoS requirements, the decision of Web services composition should be made on the fuzzy information. In this paper, an interval muti-attribute decision-making based evaluating method of QoS for composite services is presented. The method uses the interval numbers to describe the QoS parameters of the Web services, as well as the customers’ QoS requirements. The method for measuring interval-valued QoS parameters and aggregation are also proposed. With the consideration of the Characteristics of the customers’ requirements, the evaluation on QoS parameters is made to construct the decision-making matrix following the principle of "To be appropriate for Customers’ requirements". Finally, based on the matrix, a comprehensive evaluation is made by using TOPSIS. By assessing the customer satisfaction and interactivity, it gives a comprehensive evaluation on the composite Web service based on uncertain multi-attribute decision making method. With the help of the adaptive genetic algorithm, it tries to find the appropriate composite service that meets the global QoS requirements of the customers.

Author Keywords: TOPSIS(Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to an Ideal Solution)

articleTitle: A fast multipole method of fundamental solutions for two dimensional acoustic scattering problems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: A fast multipole method of fundamental solutions (FMMFS) for two dimension acoustic scattering problems is presented by combining the method of fundamental solutions (MFS) with the fast multipole method (FMM), the main idea of the FMM is to translate the node-to-node interactions to cell-to-cell interactions. Numerical simulations shows that FMMFS can potentially reduce the operations in formulations and solution of the MFS system, from O(N<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) and O(N<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>) all to O(N log N), where N is the number of equations of the linear system, and improve the efficiency of the sound field prediction.

Author Keywords: Fast multipole method of fundamental solutions

articleTitle: Accurate Recommendation of Tourist Routes Based on Improved Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In view of the fact that accurate travel route recommendation can not meet the actual needs of users, this paper designs a travel route recommendation method based on improved artificial bee colony algorithm. In order to control the update dimension of the artificial bee colony algorithm and balance the search and development ability of the algorithm, a dimension change strategy is designed. The improved artificial bee colony algorithm improves the convergence speed and accuracy of the algorithm. Select tourist attractions according to tourists' preferences, and obtain the collection of tourist attractions through tourists' comprehensive score of tourist attractions. The improved artificial bee colony algorithm is extended to establish an accurate tourism route recommendation model with the shortest tourism path as the objective function and the least time and cost as the constraints. The test results show that the accuracy, recall and coverage of tourism route precise recommendation based on the improved artificial bee colony algorithm are better than those based on particle swarm optimization algorithm, ant colony algorithm and unmodified artificial bee colony algorithm, which can bring good tourism experience to tourists.

articleTitle: Network Public Opinion Monitoring Method Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To ensure the public safety of social networks, this paper designs and implements a public opinion monitoring system based on Sina Weibo. A design scheme based on machine learning and word segmentation technology is proposed. Jieba Chinese word segmentation tool is used to realize text preprocessing, text classification and tendency analysis. When classifying according to the emotional weight of emotional words in the text, LSTM model is used to improve the analysis efficiency and accuracy of machine learning. At the same time, the web page library update strategy for the public opinion analysis system is formulated to ensure the freshness of the local web page library. The experimental test analysis shows that such scheme can classify the emotional tendency of microblog content, and find out the news with high attention and strong emotion of netizens, and make the corresponding trend prediction, which achieves the purpose of public opinion monitoring.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Power Market Comprehensive Development Index based on Power Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to build a comprehensive development index analysis system of power market based on big data, the relationship model between power data and comprehensive development index of power market is established.From the model analysis, the competitiveness of power market has a significant impact on the effectiveness and stability of power market. The positive path coefficient shows that this impact is positively correlated. In order to improve the stability and effectiveness of the power market, it is necessary to improve the competitiveness of the power market. Finally, it can be concluded that in the power market, the structural equation model can make good use of observable variables to quantitatively analyze potential variables such as competitiveness, stability and reliability. The empirical results are consistent with the objective situation.

Author Keywords: Big data Power market development index System

articleTitle: Measurement and Analysis of Hydration Heat for Long-span PC Box Girder Bridge
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The concrete hydration heat of long-span PC box girder bridges might cause early cracks in box girder. However, this phenomenon is easy to be ignored in engineering. In this paper, the hydration heat of two long-span PC box girder was measured in field. The mechanical property of concrete cured at the same condition of the real bridge was tested as well. Based on the tested results and finite element (FE) analysis, the temperature field and stress distribution of PC box girder during the process of concrete hydration heat was simulated using time varying model. The results showed that the calculated hydration heat agree well with the values measured in field, and the temperature and stress time history could be well simulated by the time varying model. The temperature difference was one of the main reasons which caused the early cracks in the web of box girder. The removal of shuttering time should be ensured for the stabilization of hydration heat, and should be more than 4 days with normal weather conditions.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis of Online Recruitment Information Based on Text Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technology, the statistical analysis of online recruitment information attracts more and more people's attention. Online recruitment information is often unstructured and has a large amount of data. Traditional statistics and data mining methods have become invalid. In this paper, we adopts crawler and text mining technology to carry out data collection and statistical analysis of online recruitment information, which overcomes the shortcomings of traditional analysis methods. Firstly, crawler technology is used to collect data, adopting the technical route of requests-Beautiful soup-Re. Secondly, on the basis of exploratory analysis, text mining technology is used to carry out the text clustering analysis of job requirements in the recruitment information. After the text is normalized, Word2vec model based on neural network is constructed for text vectoization to simplify the calculation. Elbow rule and contour coefficient method are used to cluster the sample data into 8 categories and 2 categories respectively. The experimental results show that the contour coefficient method has better clustering effect, and the data analysis positions are divided into two categories: technical type and business type, which has certain reference value for job seekers and educational institutions.

articleTitle: Automatic Driving Vehicle Path Planning Based on Deep Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Autonomous vehicles need to keep a certain safe distance from obstacles. Aiming at the problem of over fitting phenomenon in obstacle recognition, which leads to the reduction of path search performance, a path planning method of autonomous vehicle based on deep convolution neural network is proposed. The two-dimensional environment model is used to describe the surrounding environment of the vehicle, establish the automatic driving structured road, and generate the virtual local target points. The deep convolution neural network is used to identify obstacles. The convolution layer maps the input data to the feature space, and the full connection layer maps the feature space to the sample label space through linear transformation, that is, the final output sample category, to complete the detection of virtual target points. Use the information of the target point to search the path towards the target, remove the obstacle node through the collision check function, judge whether the expansion node has reached the target area, and realize the path planning. The simulation results show that the average search time, the average number of search nodes and the number of successful searches of the automatic driving vehicle path planning method based on deep convolution neural network proposed in this paper are better than those based on genetic algorithm and SVM. The design method has significantly improved the search speed and efficiency.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent campus logo guidance system based on machine vision
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the unreasonable design of smart campus logo guidance system, this paper puts forward the design of smart campus logo guidance system based on machine vision, improves the spatial configuration of hardware structure of smart campus logo guidance system, improves the operation function of system software, and simplifies the operation steps, Combined with the principle of machine vision, the evaluation index of influencing factors of smart campus logo guidance is constructed to achieve the design goal of smart campus logo guidance system. Finally, experiments show that the design method of intelligent campus logo guidance system based on machine vision has high effectiveness and practicability in the process of practical application.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of Financial Market Risk Prediction Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The data source of financial market risk prediction is relatively single and homogeneous, resulting in inaccurate prediction results. A mathematical model of financial market risk prediction is established based on data mining. The financial market risk prediction indicators are divided into two types: internal factors and external factors. Preprocess the collected index data, including missing values, abnormal values and invalid values, and find and modify the data that does not meet the modeling requirements. The mathematical model of financial market risk prediction is constructed based on data mining, the processed index data is input into SVM based classifier, and the preference of each output category is voted. According to the main voting synthesis rule, the prediction results of the base classifier are synthesized to obtain the final prediction results. The test results show that the prediction accuracy of the financial market risk prediction mathematical model based on data mining is significantly higher than that based on mathematical statistics and DWT-SVM.

articleTitle: Analysis of ultimate bearing capacity of foundations based on machine learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper presents an analysis method of ultimate bearing capacity of foundations based on machine learning. Firstly, based on the clustering algorithm of machine learning, the numerical results are processed to obtain the failure mode of the foundation under the limit state, and the equilibrium solution of the ultimate bearing capacity of shallow foundation and caisson foundation is deduced. Then, the numerical solution and equilibrium solution of the ultimate bearing capacity of shallow foundation and caisson foundation are compared with Prandtl's theoretical solution and centrifugal model test results respectively; Finally, the correctness of foundation numerical simulation method and the effectiveness of machine learning clustering algorithm in finding foundation failure mode under vertical load are verified.

articleTitle: Research on Accounting Information Credit Risk Measurement System Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The accounting information credit risk measurement system has the problem of difficult information sharing, resulting in low ROC index. An accounting information credit risk measurement system is designed based on blockchain. The hardware part adds the support of a variety of high-speed interfaces in the module integration, selects the SoC chip as the main control chip of the processor module, and designs the clock circuit to realize the functions of timer and clock output. In the software part, the risk measurement system database is established, and the logarithmic processing method is used to describe the rate of return, so as to provide a data basis for risk measurement. A node uploads data to the network platform, establishes an accounting information credit risk measurement model based on the blockchain, and contracts with information circulate in the block to realize credit risk measurement. The system test results show that the ROC of the accounting information credit risk measurement system based on blockchain is higher than that based on SVM and random forest, and has good default prediction effect.

articleTitle: Intersection traffic flow prediction based on deep neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the increasingly serious problem of intersection traffic congestion, an intersection traffic flow prediction method based on deep neural network is proposed. The principle of deep neural network is used to construct the intersection traffic congestion management system, standardize the intersection traffic flow evaluation algorithm, and reasonably predict and manage the intersection traffic flow. Finally, the experiment proves that the intersection traffic flow prediction method based on deep neural network has high practicability and accuracy in the process of practical application, and fully meets the research requirements.

articleTitle: Human-Machine Co-Driving Mode Switching Method of Autonomous Vehicles based on Traffic Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Human-machine co-driving is a commonly used vehicle control mode in automatic driving. However, due to the gradual improvement of technology informatization speed, the traditional driving mode is no longer suitable for the development of today's society. Therefore, the human-machine co-driving mode switching method of automatic driving vehicles based on traffic scenarios is proposed. At the same time, the driving switch feature selection and lane change intention control recognition are carried out, and the automatic driving longitudinal assistance switch architecture is created in traffic scenes. The human-machine co-driving mode switching model of multi-objective autonomous vehicles is designed in traffic scenes. The ADHDP iterative interactive verification is carried out to realize the human-machine co-driving mode switch of autonomous vehicles. The final test results showed that test in different target driving distance, comparing with the traditional hybrid switching test groups, characteristics of target handoff method finally concluded relatively fast switching speed. It also shows that this design method has better stability, switch in the switching process, fast, can achieve smooth switching smoothly, has a certain practical significance.
